tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras bcas bstan srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'dod don gsol ba'i yi ge dge legs bsam don lhun grub zhes bya ba bzhugs so// stobs bcu mnga' ba yongs kyi phrin las rnams// gcig bsdus margad mdangs 'dzin sgrol ma la// 'jigs brgyad skyob ma'i sku brnyan gyis bskor ba// bsod nams rgyal mtshan can gyis dad pas bzhengs// 'dis mtshon dge bas gnas skabs 'jigs brgyad sogs// bar chad bro 'tshal dus min 'chi rigs las// rnam rgyal dkon mchog gsum dngos sgrol ma yi// thugs rje'i gur khyim gegs med bde bar 'tsho// dal 'byor ljon pa bsod nams lo 'dab brgyas// rgyal gsung snying po sdom gsum me tog dkar// rim gnyis bsgom pa'i snye mas yongs dud cing*// don gnyis 'dod dgu'i dga' ston 'gyed par shog /ces pa'i 'dod gsol 'di'ang ban+de tshul rin gyis so// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //mdog bzang rdul brtsegs ri bor nyin mor byed// 'char ka'i 'od khyab mthong thos skye 'gro rnams// 'khor ba ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las bskyab bzod na// thub mchog sku yi rjes 'gror bsngags par 'os// bstan pa'i 'byung gnas ston pa'i sku brnyan la// bstan skyong gnas brtan 'khor gyis bskor ba 'di// bstan pa'i rjes zhugs dpal ldan phun tshogs kyis// bstan pa mchog dang rtag tu mjal phyir bzhengs// dge tshogs khyung sngon skyes kyis mdun bsu bas// dad sgrol sa skya pa dang e waṃ pa// rnam gnyis bstan pa dbyer med ma zlum gyi// bshad sgrub phrin las 'od stong rgyas phyir bsngo// dpal gyi gzhir gyur bstan pa'i rjes zhugs nas// las byed de yang bcom ldan thub pa'i gsung*// thos bsam bsgoms pa las byung yon tan rnams// phun tshogs rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob nyid byin rlobs// skye ba 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar// bar ma chad du sdom pa gsum ldan lus// lus med thul mchog gsung la blo gros gsal// gsal byed smra ba'i dbang phyug thob par shog

/ces pa thub dbang bris sku bzhengs pa'i bsngo byang 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //'phags mchog chu skyes phyag gi sgyu 'phrul gzugs// dngos grub rnam gnyis sbyin pa'i thugs rje yi// dpag bsam rkang 'thung lta bur rgyas pa las// sems can re 'dod 'gengs pa'i mgon po dkar// gang gi gzugs skur mkha' 'gro nor sbyin lhas// kun nas bskor ba rlung gi rgyal mtshan dang*// mtshungs las dngos grub zung gi khyad par can// dbu mdzad dpal ldan phun tshogs can gyis bzhengs// rnam dkar dge bas skye dgur phan bde'i gzhi// brtse chen snying po thabs shes yi ge yis// nyer mtshan bstan pa'i bshad sgrub dbyangs snyan can// 'dus tshogs rgyas pas sa steng mdzes par shog /dpal stug bstan pa'i rjes 'jug sdom gsum gyi// skal bar ldan bdag bsod nams pir gyi rtses// brgya phrag bsgyur te bskrun pa'i dge mtshan dpal// phun tshogs rgyal ba'i gzugs sku mngon gyur nas// mtha' yas 'gro tshogs srid las gdon par shog /gnas skabs kun du dal rten ngang pa'i bu// chos dang srid pa'i dpal 'byor chu gter klong*// lung rtogs yon tan rtsal sgro rab rdzogs nas// don gnyis grub pa'i 'phur lding bsgyur bar shog /ces mgon dkar bris sku bskrun pa'i bsngo ba smon lam lag rjes bcas 'di'ang*/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ ༈ //pra ṇi dha na sid+dhir+bha wa tu// ston mchog ngan 'gro sbyong ba'i ting 'dzin la// snyoms zhugs 'od kyi snang chen spros pa'i mod// lha bus nyer mtshon ngan song lus can rnams// skad cig bde bar sbyar der phyag 'tshal nas// gang tshe legs gsungs zil dngar ngan song gsum// sbyong byed rgyud sde'i brtag pas bsten bya'i gtso// kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa dang*// de yi sgrub mchod phyir bzlog dbang bskur bsags// rgyal kun mthu stobs gcig gyur gsang ba'i bdag

/gang skur rigs lnga'i rgyal bas yongs bskor ba// gtsug lag rtsis babs skyon dang bar chad bdud// pham byed ston pa'i cho 'phrul mchod rten bskrun// gcig tu sngon las dbang gi btsan pa khos// ngan 'gro'i sgo ngan 'byed la brtson srid na// mi 'khrugs rgyal po'i las sgrib sbyong ba'i sngags// bzhi 'bum bzlas pa'i byin rlabs mthu nus rnams// 'khor gsum dmigs med klong du bsdams pa'i mthus// dus 'das 'jam dbyangs grags pa zhes bya yi// sdig sgrib kun sbyangs tshogs zung rdzogs pa'i sems// 'od dpag med drung brdzus te skye bar shog /de srid skye bar dal 'byor rdzogs pa'i lus// bla ma dkon mchog nam yang mi 'bral bar// gzhung mang thos bsam bsgoms pas rgyud sbyangs nas// bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i byed por shog /bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje dang*// yi dam chos skyong srung ma'i mthu rtsal gyis// gang dag smras don gegs med 'grub pa yi// bden stobs sa bon stobs su rdzogs gyur cig /ces dus 'das 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i skye sgo ngan pa 'gegs phyir rten bzhengs dge rdzong rnams kyi bsngo ba smon lam don yod zhags pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dpyod ldan shes rab chos 'phel gyi ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas 'phral du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //pra ṇa dhi sid+dho bha wa tu/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yum// shes rab pha rol phyin chen tshigs su bcad// stong phrag brgya pa glegs bam nyi ma'i grangs// rgyu rkyen legs sbyar skal bzang mgron du gnyer// chos spyod dge bcu sbyang ba'i bsod nams stobs// ji snyed gzugs can bskrun pa'i mthu chen thob// gal te mchis na srid pas theg dka'i dogs// brtan mas lus phyed steng du phyung ngam snyam// dge tshogs lha yi chu bos dmigs pa'i yul// ye shes rin chen gyis mtshon mar gyur 'gro'i// sgo gsum sgrib gnyis dri ma yongs bkrus nas// tshogs gnyis rin chen 'byung gnas rgyas phyir bsngo// 'brel thogs kun kyang byang chub bar gyi skyer// dal 'byor rten ldan sdig spang dge bar brtson// rgyal bstan dri med sgor zhugs thos bsam dang*// bsgom byung yon tan gter la dbang 'byor shog

/sangs rgyas bkra shis spangs rtogs rtse mor phyin// dam chos bkra shis thog mtha' bar du dge /dge 'dun bkra shis lha mi'i mchod pa'i gnas// skyabs gsum bkra shis des 'dir bde legs shog /ces sbyin bdag che ge mos sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa bsod nams kyi dpal du spyan drangs pa'i bsngo byang 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //rang bzhin skye ba med pa dbyings kyi shel// ma 'gags lhun grub chos dang longs spyod rdzogs// sprul sku bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams// sna tshogs tshon dang phrad ltar snang ba'i gzugs// gang 'di 'tsho byed blo bzang bstan dar gyis// dad phyag mchod 'bul gsol ba gdab yul du// rgyu rkyen legs sbyar bzo rig mkhas pa'i yid// dgyes bskyed sde dge lhun grub steng du bskrun// rnam dkar dge ba'i nyi mas gnas skabs su// bar chad nyer 'tshe'i shun rgya yongs grol nas// tshogs zung spyod pa'i 'dab stong rgyas pa'i dbus// sku gsum dbyer med 'bras bus dud par shog /ces pa 'di'ang pad 'byung gtso 'khor gyi bris sku'i bsngo byang du tshul rin gyis so// ༈ //sgron me'i bskal pa'i sems dpa' stong phrag las// gdul dka'i 'gro 'dul g.yar dam smon lam mthus// dus 'dir 'tshang rgya'i tshul bstan khams gsum du// chos kyi snang chen 'gyed pa zas gtsang sras// gang gi sku brnyan rgyu bzang rin chen las// 'phrul bzos bskrun par ston pa'i mchog nyid nas// rang dang gnyis su med par byin brlabs pa'i// skye dgu'i mchod sdong shākya mu nīn+d+rar// kho bo tsha rgyud bcas pa gus pa'i lus// grangs med sprul pa'i tshogs kyis yan lag lnga// g.yar lam sa gzhir ngal gso spyod snyam gyis// lan brgyar btud pa'i phyag gi phreng ba brtsegs// bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan bzang 'bar ba'i skur// tha mal tshon gyis lham pa mi srid kyang*// rgyal ba'i gzugs sku sgrub pa'i nyer bsdogs su// rin chen gser sbyangs khu ba'i byug pa dang*// nyer spyod snang gsal sgron ma'i phreng bstar bas// nyer mtshon lus dang longs spyod dge ba'i tshogs// sa gzhi ri gling rgya mtshor bcas pa la// lha mi'i 'byor pas gtams pa'i mchod sprin 'bul// nyon mongs dug gsum rtog pas nyer bslangs pa'i// kha na ma tho bsags dang ston pa'i mchog

/khyod gsung mdo sngags bcas pa'i bslab bya dang*// 'gal ba'i nyes ltung ji snyed mthol zhing bshags// 'khor ba mya ngan las 'das byed po yis// chags sdang rmongs pa'i than pas ma bzhu ba'i// lhas bskos kha ba'i rdul brtsegs lhun po la// yi rang kun phan 'od kyis ches dkar bgyi// zab yangs chos kyi 'byung gnas chen po rnams// chos kun ngal gsor spyod pa bdag mi 'gog /'on te thar pa'i lam stor sems can ngor// chos 'khor bskor ba'i dam bca' cang dral lam// thub pa'i nyi ma myangs 'das chu lha yi// sa 'dzin lkog tu yibs la mngon phyogs rnams// byang chub thugs bskyed smon lam 'phrin yig tu// 'gro kun ma grol de srid bzhugs rgyur dgongs// de dag gis bskyed bde rgyu gang mchis pas// mar gyur 'gro ba mu med 'khor ba ru// sdug bsngal de rgyus gdungs pa skad cig rer// bde ba'i go 'phang sbyor ba'i mgon gyur cig /mchog gi go sa grub pa de srid kyi// skye bar kho bo dbon rgyud slob 'khor bcas// mi khom brgyad du nam yang mi skye zhing*// dal 'byor skyon bral rten ldan skye bar shog /sdug bsngal 'byung gnas sdig pa'i las spong zhing*// bde ba'i 'byung gnas dge tshogs sgrub la brtson// lung ma bstan yang dge ba'i lam bsgyur nas// 'jig rten yang dag lta bas brgyan par shog /skyon bral so sor thar pa'i 'dab stong bzhad// rgyal sras spyod pa'i ge sar 'bum bdo zhing*// rig 'dzin sngags kyi lta sgom spyod pa yi// sdom gsum 'bras bu'i lta ba mngon mthor shog /bslab bya thams cad mkhyen rgyu phyi nang gi /gzhung lugs legs sbyangs blo gros a dar+sha// thos bsam bsgom gsum bya bas brdar ba'i ngos// lung rigs gdams pa'i ltad mo bkrag tu che// stobs bcu mnga' ba de sras bcas pa yi// lung rtogs nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od bzhin du// ches gsal byed pa 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis// 'gro blo'i ma rig mun pa drung 'byin shog

/gang tshe 'chi med tshe dang bsod nams stobs// srid zhi'i dpal 'byor mkhas pa'i phrin las rnams// gaṅgā'i chu klung rin chen 'byung gnas che// ri dbang nyi zla'i 'od kyi rjes 'gror shog /chos srid bde 'byor legs bris phun tshogs la// phrag dog bcud mi ldan pa'i dpung tshogs kyis// byad gtad smra mchu ngan pa'i g.yul sham pa// byin rlabs lha dbang stobs kyi choms shig gu// yal ga lcug phreng lo 'dab kun nas rgyas// ci 'dod 'bras bu bskyed pas phyir zhing 'phel// grib bsil yid 'ong 'jo ba'i dpag bsam shing*// dga' tshal mdzes pa'i dpyid du brtan gyur cig /nyag gcig skyabs kyi dam pa'i thugs rje dang*// rgyu 'bras bslu med nges pa'i bden stobs kyis// 'dod don smon pa'i lam du gang song ba// snye ma gegs bral smin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi bu ram shing skyes ston pa mchog dang mi gnyis pa'i shākya mu ne'i sku brnyan la/ yan lag bdun pa'i mchod 'bul 'dod gsol bcas pa'i tshigs bcad dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i mgrin glu zhes bya ba 'di ni shākya'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi bsti gnas su bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes chu gter che// 'gro 'dul smon lam ri bos bsrubs pa'i bcud// chos kun bdag med rtogs pa'i snang ba mchog /sbyin mdzad 'jam dpal nyin mo'i mgon la 'dud// gang gi snang brnyan dge mtshan gzi byin gter// ye shes sems dpa' nyid dang mi gnyis par// byin rlabs su zhig mthong thos dran tsam gyis// bsod nams bye ba'i phung po'i 'bab stegs can// gang la stong 'khun yul gyi 'phrul bzo pas// dus 'khor snying po tshangs pa'i yi ge'i gzugs// thags su bskrun pa'i snyan shal gyis mtshon pa'i// dngos 'byor yid byung gya nom mdor gling 'bul// grangs med lus btud phyag 'tshal sdig ltung bshags// skye 'phags dge la yi rang chos smra cher// chos sgra 'byin bskul rtag tu bzhugs par gsol// dge ba rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo// de srid skye bar kho bo tsha 'khor bcas// mi khom gnas brgyad skye ba'i rgyun bcad de// bsod nams rgyu rkyen phun tshogs rten 'byung gis// dal 'byor rten gyi dpag bsam bskyed du gsol// gang tshe 'jam dbyangs dbyangs kyi rgyal mor bcas// dge ba'i bshes mchog mchog tu bzung ba'i mthus// sdug bsngal gzhi ma ma rig rmongs pa'i sgrib// khyed cag thugs rjes rjes med bsal du gsol// thams cad mkhyen rgyu phyi nang rig pa'i gzhung*// bcu phrag thos bsam sgom pa'i blo gros rgyas// dpyad gsum dag pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom pa la// mi 'jigs spobs pa dag gi dbang phyug stsol// rgyal ba rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rim byon gyi// bstan pa lung rigs tshad gnyis dbang po yis// lan gcig min par bsngags pa'i yul 'di ko

/mkhas tshul gsum gyis kun tu rgyas byed shog /bdag la re ltos bcas pa'i gson gshin 'gro// kun kyang mchog gsum skyabs kyi grib mar chud// phan tshun byams dang brtse ba'i 'dzum bsu zhing*// gzhan don rgyal ba'i myu gu'i sems mchog bskyed// de dag spyod la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// zhes dpal sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba'i snyan shal dang phyag mchod stob kyin 'dod gsol yid kyi shing rta zhes bya ba 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis smras pa sarbār+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //dpag yas tshogs gnyis zung 'jug stobs su rdzogs// sngags spyod grub pa'i gom pas rdo rje'i sa'i// 'od srungs byin rab gnon pa'i rdo rje 'chang*// grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dga' byed mchog /dad sgrol chen pos gsang gsum yon tan mtha'// dpag yas dpe zlas dben na mi rung zhes// kun gsal rang lus mu med dngos kun la// ma khyab med pa'i bdag nyid sprul lam snyam// 'on te thun mong blo ngor shar ba'i sku// 'dra bar sprul pa'i byin rlabs gzi brgya pa// su zhig gsol btab 'bras bu rtog med du// lhug par stsol ba'i lha mi'i mchog sdong che// phyogs re'i che ba'i yon tan tshogs gsum breng*// yid kyi ngos gzher bkod pa'i phyag dang mnyam// ma hā tsi na'i 'phrul bzos btags pa'i dar// brjod bya snyan ngag lam du song bas mchod// mdo sngags bstan pa'i dgongs pa gsal byed pa// smra mchog dbang po'i grangs ldan khyed cag gi /bstan pa bshad sgrub brtson pa'i blo ldan bcas// rgya mtsho'i gos khyab rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// bstan pa'i rjes su slob bdag slob 'bangs bcas// deng nas byang chub bar gyi skye nas skyer// khom pa med pa'i gnas brgyad mi skye bar// dal 'byor bco brgyad chos ldan thob par mdzod// khyed gsung dri med smra bas bstan pa'i sgor// rjes bzung tshul khrims la gnas phyi nang gi

/gtsug lag kun la sbyangs pas dag pa'i blo// srid pa'i mun pa 'phrog pa'i byed por mdzod// gang tshe byang chub bsgrub pa'i dal rten la// sdang sems dgra 'dra'i sbrul gdug khros pa yi// mthu gtad rtsod pa'i kha rlangs gang 'thul ba// thugs rje nus pa'i sman gyi gzhil mdzod cig /gzhan don thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas// bsgrub phyir sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i// bstan bya lta sgom spyod pa legs spyad pas// lung rtogs yon tan kun la dbang 'byor shog /yid ches lung rigs gdams pa'i khong yangs nas// legs par 'phos pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yi// phrin las nyi zla'i snang bas gar khyab par// dam pa'i chos kyang rgyas pa'i byed por mdzod// bstan 'dzin skyes mchog rnams kyi zhabs pad brtan// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang dpal 'byor rgyas// bstan pa'i rjes 'jug sa steng kun tu khyab// bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs// ces rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan pa'i snang brnyan la phyag mchod snyan shal 'bul ba'i 'dod gsol 'chi med gling bu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dad pa'i nor can tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarbo3r+tha si dhaṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //thub dbang mgur gyi dbyangs snyan tam+bu raḥ /tshangs dbyangs snyan pa'i rgyud stong 'khrol ba las// mdo sde'i dbang po zung gi snyan dngags glu// mi 'gyur phreng ba bstar bas ji skad du// chos smra'i skyes bu kun dga' bzang zhes pas// nga yi bstan la mkhas pa'i tshul gsum gyi// bya ba bgyis mthar bde ldan mgon po'i drung*// gshegs par 'gyur ba'i 'phrin snyan rna bar 'jebs// gang gi snang brnyan rgyal dang de sras kyi// ring bsrel snying pos gtams pa'i go rer yang*// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing khams gaṅgā'i rdul// ji snyed bkod pa rdzogs par byin gyis brlabs// su zhig lta byed dbang po'i yul shar tsam// dad phyag mchod pa'i phreng bas mdun bdar te// thun mong mchog dngos gsol btab ci dang ci// lag rtser sbyin pa yid bzhin nor bu'i mchog

/gang la grangs med lus btud phyag 'tshal zhing*// stong 'khun yul grur skyes pa'i 'phrul bzo yis// mtshams sprin gzhon nu'i lang tsho co 'dri'i gos// nye bar spyod sogs sgo gsum longs spyod bcas// gser gyi sa gzhi lcags ri'i 'khor yug gis// zlum por bskor dbus rin chen ri bo'i phreng*// chu gter nyin mtshan sgron ma zung gsal ba'i// dpal 'byor phun tshogs maṇ+ḍal sprul te phul// sdig ltung bshags zhing dge la rjes yi rang*// skyabs gsum bdag nyid mchog la skyabs 'gro zhing*// bden gnyis zung 'jug smon dang 'jug sems spyod// dge tshogs bla med byang chub thob phyir bsngo// de srid skye bar bdag cag gnyen mdza' bshes// kun kyang mi khom brgyad du mi skye zhing*// dal 'byor chos dang nam yang mi 'bral bar// dam pas rjes bzung tshul khrims bslab pas gtsang*// phyi nang gtsug lag sbyangs pa'i lus rtsal rdzogs// lung rigs gdams pa'i ral pa'i khur gyis mdzes// 'chad rtsom brtsad pa'i seng ge'i sgra dbyangs kyis// rnam 'dren bstan pa'i gangs ri skyong ba la// phrag dog gzhan sde 'khyog por 'gro ba'i khas// byad gtad dug gi kha rlangs 'thul ba dang*// keg sri 'thab rtsod mun pa gang 'thibs pa// mgon khyod thugs rje'i nyi mas gzhil mdzod cig /mdo sngags snying po'i dgongs don khyod kyi bstan// bshad sgrub mkhas tshul gsum la dbang 'byor pa'i// blo ldan grangs med tshogs dang lhan cig nyid// nor 'dzin kun khyab rgyas par mdzad du gsol// zhes e waṃ pa chen po'i sku brnyan yid bzhin nor bu la phyag mchod snyan shal 'bul ba'i 'dod gsol bkra shis dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //dpal stug kun gyi bya grub ye shes khams// yid 'phrog dar bab rgyan gyi brgyan ma'i gzugs// yid la dran gyin gsol ba btab tsam gyis// 'jigs las skyob pa'i rje btsun sgrol ma kye// deng 'dir bkra shis nor bu 'khor 'bangs bcas// tshogs bsags dam chos thos bsam bsgrub pa'i phyir// gtsang dbus kun du 'gro sdod 'ong ba yi// gnas skabs kun tu thugs rje'i phyag rkyong la// 'gal rkyen nad yams 'brum thor gdon bgegs kyi// nyer 'tshe kun dang dgra jag tshom rkun sogs// las 'phrang chu bo 'jigs pa thams cad las// bde bar sgrol ba'i mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod// rnam pa gcig tu 'di nas byang chub bar// thams cad mkhyen rgyu phyi nang shes bya'i gzhung*// thos bsam sgom pa'i bslab sbyangs las byung ba'i// lung rtogs yon tan rgyas par mdzad du gsol// rgyal ba rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rim byon gyi// phrin las rgyun mi chad pa'i dar rgyas su// bskyang bar mkhas la 'os pa'i lam gsum gyis// 'gro khams phan bde'i 'byung gnas mdzad du gsol// zhes sgrol ma myur ma dpal mo'i thugs rgyud bskul ba'i 'dod gsol 'dod 'jo'i ba mo zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/

ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarbār+tha sidhaṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //brgya phrag bsod nams tshogs pa'i byed po yis// skyes bu chen po'i mgul par rdzogs pa'i mtshan// bkra shis rtags su byin rlabs dbyangs snyan pos// rgud pa'i rims nad gzhi la de rmad byung*// swasti'i sgra dbyangs bskul dang lhan cig tu// yon tan ldan pa'i zhing gyur sdom brtson gyi// dge 'dun gur gum rgyas pa'i nags kyi dpal// phra mor bgyid la bsnyen bkur bsdebs pa'i dge /kho bo gnyen bshes pha mas thog drangs 'gro// kun kyang rtag tu mdo sngags chos thos zhing*// bsam sgom yon tan mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbyangs// sa gsum khongs su ldir ba'i rgyur gyur cig /ces dpal sa skya'i chos dung dkar po rgyang grag gsung bskul dang dge 'dun bsnyen bkur bstab pa'i bsngo byang 'di ni ban+de tshul rin gyis so// ༈ //rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes chu gter che// smon lam dus bab man+dā rwa bas bsrubs pa'i bcud// dpag yas mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar can// rgyal bstan bde 'byung gtsug rgyan kun dga' bzang*// ma phyis rab tu dwangs pa thub dbang mkhyen pa'i ngos// byed pos ma bris bstan par phan pa'i bshes gnyen du// gzhan gyis ma bskul lung gi bsngags pa'i dbyangs snyan can// ma bteg bstan 'dzin yongs kyi dbus na mngon mtho ba// gang gi phrin las lugs bzang mkhas pa'i las gsum gyi// phyogs kyi pha rol song ba'i ngo mtshar blta ba'i ched// lha rdzing ring mos nyi zla'i gsal sgron thogs nas ni// nyin mtshan re mos lan gcig min par 'tshol min nam// de lta'i legs mdzad snang ba dam pas bskal pa'i bar// ris bral blo gros sgrib pa 'phrog pa'i cho ga mkhan// rtag par 'jo la thabs shes yi ges nyer mtshan pa'i// dbang gi dmar mdangs 'tsher ba'i gtsug lag khang chen por// dpal ldan bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs// mchod yul rab 'byams dri ldan pad+ma'i dga' tshal du// dngos grub sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston sbyin la cang dga' ba'i// rkang drug tshogs kyi 'phur lding g.yo bas rtsen 'dra der// sdom pa gsum gyi bslab bya'i yul la legs slob cing*// gzhan don khur chen khyer ba ngur smrig 'chang ba 'dus pa'i sde// gur gum me tog rgyas pa'i nags tshal dang mtshungs las// gzhan pa'i dpe zla srid na rnyed min 'dus pa'i tshogs// bcom ldan thams cad rig pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod phyir// dngos 'byor yid sprul dpag yas mchod pa'i sprin chen gyis// gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor khyab par spro dang lhan cig tu// gsung bskul dgyes pa'i bsnyen bkur gral 'gyed stob las byung*// rnam dkar dge ba'i kun phan gsar pa'i 'od phreng gis// sdig sgrib nyes ltung pad+ma'i 'ching rgya yongs dbral nas// tshogs gnyis ku mud 'dab ma stong phrag bye ba'i dbus// don gnyis lhun grub mchog gi 'bras bu smin gyur cig

/de nyid mngon gyur bar gyi skye ba'i tshe rabs phreng*// kho bo gnyen bshes gson gshin gyis mtshon sems can rnams// mi khom brgyad du gzhar yang mi skye dal 'byor rten// dkon mchog rnam gsum skyabs kyi dam pa thob par shog /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob gyur nas tshul khrims ldan// phyi nang gtsug lag rig pa'i rin chen mi zad gter// dbang 'byor 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum mkhas pa'i phrin las kyis// rnam 'dren bstan dang sems can phan pa'i byed por shog /gang tshe byang chub spyod pa'i rmad byung a gas+t+yas// las nyon bag chags bcas pa'i ngan g.yo'i lha min dpung*// bden gnyis zung 'jug rtogs pa'i gsus par bcil te slar// yon tan chu klung bye ba btung ba'i mthu ldan shog /bsod nams gser gyi sa gzhi lta bu yangs pa'i 'phang*// sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs chu gter che ltar 'khyil// tshe srog ri bo mchog rab bzhin du mi shigs brling*// chos srid phrin las snang byed zung gi 'od 'dra yis// lus can sngon med phan bde'i ga zha 'byin par shog /dge spyod smin legs si ta 'phrog la mngon phyogs pa'i// nad gdon dgra 'dre khros pa'i bar chad 'bod sgrogs gzugs// dkon mchog thugs rje'i mda' gzhu bskyod pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis// dus min 'chi rigs ming gi lhag ma tsam du mdzod// ces e waṃ chos ldan du sdom brtson dge 'dun 'dus par kun rig sgrub mchod gsung bskul zhus pa'i bsnyen bkur gral 'gyed stob pa'i dus kyi 'dod gsol bkra shis 'khyil pa'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ ngag dbang tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas bris nas phul ba sarbo3r+tha sid+dhi bha wa tu// ༈ //rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsang gsum dang*// yon tan phrin las gcig bsdus snyigs ma 'dir// dpyod ldan kun dga'i dpal bskyed mkhas dang btsun// bzang po'i gar gyi 'gro 'dul mchog gis skyongs// yid srubs thul mchog gang gi lhun grub dang*// rgyun mi chad pa'i phrin las bshad sgrub kyi// chos 'khor mi nub bskal par skyong ba'i gzhi// e waṃ yi ge'i mtshan pa'i chos grwa cher// yul sde ris su bcas pa'i khang tshan grangs// gdengs can zla bar gnas pa'i ya gyal gyi// mchod yul bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras// bstan srung sprin bzhin 'du ba'i kun dga' rwar// bstan pa'i snying po sdom gsum bslab pa la// gus pa lhur len ngur smrig 'chang gi tshogs// 'dus par mang ja'i bsnyen bkur dkon mchog la// gos bzang 'phen gyi mchod 'bul 'di bgyis pas// rnam dkar dge bas sbyin bdag ltos 'khor bcas// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs nas// sku gsum gsang ba mi zad rgyan gyi mdzod// yon tan bsam mi khyab bdag mngon gyur shog

/de thob bar gyi skye ba'i ba ku la// gtsug lag smra ba'i yid 'phrog kha chang gi /bcu phrag rig pa'i 'dab stong grol ba las// legs bshad bung ba'i sgra dbyangs 'byin par shog /thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub la dgra 'dre yis// nyer 'tshe nad gdon bar chad kun zhi nas// bde dga' 'byor ba'i mtho ris yon tan bdun// dgyes dgur rtsen pa'i dbang phyug nyid gyur cig /ces e waṃ khang tshan pa'i gtsug lag khang du grwa tshogs bsnyen bkur dang dkon mchog mchod pa'i gos 'phan phul ba'i bsngo byang nyung ngu 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel// ༈ //kun mkhyen nyi ma'i rtsa lag rang gi bstan// mkhas tshul gsum gyis skyong phyir sprul pa'i sras// mang thos kun dga'i dpal ster mkhas btsun bzang*// grub pa'i yon tan dpag yas e waṃ pa// gang de'i lung bzang bshad sgrub bskal pa'i bar// dar rgyas 'byung ba'i gtsug lag khang chen por// 'phags tshogs dge 'dun 'dus pa'i bsnyen bkur dang*// dkon mchog mchod pa'i sprin dang dar 'phan 'di// lhun grub rgyal mtshan gyis phul dge ba yis// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i snying po sku gsum gyi// yon tan bsam mi khyab bdag mngon gyur shog /de srid skye bar bdag cag gnyen 'khor bcas// mi khom brgyad las rab 'das dal 'byor rten// bla ma lha srung tshogs dang mi 'bral zhing*// phyi nang gtsug lag mang thos sgor zhugs nas// bsam sgom yon tan 'dod dgur dbang 'byor shog /rgyal bstan sman gyi dga' tshal dar bab khrod// lung rtogs yon tan blo gros 'dab ma stong*// grol ba'i sbub las mkhas pa'i las gsum gyi// sbrang rtsi'i mgrin snyan 'jo ba'i byed por shog /ces pa 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor tshul rin gyis 'khro mdo mang thang sgar nas bris pa'o// ༈ //stobs bcu mnga' ba'i dbang phyug zas gtsang sras// de gsung snang byed sa skya'i dad grol lnga// rgyal bas lung bstan rgyal tshab kun dga' bzang*// brgyud par bcas pa'i zhabs rdul gtsug tu mchog

/de dag kun gyi phrin las lhun grub dang*// rgyun chags skyong bas sa steng snying po mchog /sgrub pa'i 'phags tshogs 'du ba'i gtsug lag khang*// bsam 'grub mthong na mngon par dga' ba'i gnas// de na skyabs gnas kun 'dus rdo rje 'chang*// sdom gsum bstan pa spel ba'i rnam rol gyis// 'gro ba byang chub lam du 'khrid byed pa// rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan gtsor bzhugs pa'i// mchod yul rab 'byams 'dus pas lhag pa'i lha'i// bde chen snying po 'dzin pa'i sgra don gyi// sgrub mchod bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang len pa'i// sa skyong chen pos tshogs bsag bskrun pa'i skabs// dad gsum nor ldan mgon po chos bzang pas// sna tshogs mchod pa'i phreng bas mdun bdar te// 'dus tshogs chen por bsnyen bkur gral 'gyed kyi// dge tshogs sgrub pa 'dis mtshon bsod nams mthus// rnam dkar bgyid pa'i sbyin bdag ltos 'khor bcas// zab yangs tshogs gnyis zung 'jug spyod gru yis// 'gro tshogs sdug bsngal mtsho las sgrol byed pa'i// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ded dpon thob gyur cig /de srid skye bar mi khom gnas brgyad du// lhung bar 'gyur ba'i las sgrib kun sbyangs nas// dal brgyad 'byor bcu ldan pa'i lus rten gyis// dkon mchog gsum po skyabs su thob par shog /dkar min las las sdug bsngal kun 'byung zhing*// legs byas bsags las bde ba 'byung shes nas// sdig spang dge ba sgrub la rang 'jug cing*// gzhan dag de la sbyor ba'i byed por shog /rgyal sras 'jug sgo byang chub sems mchog bskyed// rgyal sras gzhung gi lta sgom spyod pa rnams// rgyal ba'i myu gu'i tshul gyis legs spyad nas// rgyal ba'i gdung mchog 'tshob pa nyid gyur cig /theg mchog smra ba'i rdo rje slob dpon las// dbang thob dam tshig ldan pa'i spyod mchog gis// thun mong mchog dngos grub pa'i phrin las kyis// rang gzhan don chen 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/tshe 'dir tshe ring nad dang sdug bsngal bral// dge chos dpal 'byor rgyas pa brgya byin gyi// stobs 'byor phun sum tshogs pa yul gru 'dir// yongs su 'phos snyam nyid du dbang 'byor shog /ces pa 'di'ang gnyer chen mgon po chos bzang pas 'du ba chen po'i skabs su sgrub mchod kyi tshogs chen a mchod bcas la bsnyen bkur gral 'gyed stob pa'i dus kyi bsngo byang du ban+de tshul rin gyis bris so// ༈ //stobs bcu mnga' ba nyi ma'i gnyen mchog la// rgyal sras dgra bcom gyis bskor sku brnyan 'di// su zhig mthong dang dad phyag mchod byas pa'i// bsod nams gaṅgā'i klung chen 'bebs pa gang*// mchog gsum skyabs su bzung nas gzhan don du// byang chub thob phyir blo bzang bstan dar gyis// bod chen lhun grub steng gi chos grwa cher// mthun rkyen legs sbyar bsod nams zhing du bskyon// 'dis mtshon dge bas rnam mkhyen thob kyi bar// yang srid kun tu rgyal gsung sde snod gsum// thos bsam bsgom pa'i yon tan mthar phyin nas// sku gsum zung 'jug sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces pa'i bsngo byang 'di'ang 'tsho byed dam pa'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༈ //skyabs gsum kun 'dus yongs 'dzin 'khor lo'i mgon// gser zhun cod paṇa 'chang ba'i sgyu 'phrul gar// theg gsum sngags kyi lta spyod bsgom pa'i lam// rim brgyud dpal ldan bla mas yongs bskor ba// brgyud pa'i byin rlabs yal ga phyogs bral du// bskyed phyir 'tsho byed blo bzang bstan dar gyis// lhun grub steng du bzo rigs mkhas pas bskrun// des bskyed dge ba'i rtsa bas skye nas skyer// dal 'byor rten ldan chos smra mchog drin gyis// zab yangs dam pa'i chos kyi dbang 'byor nas// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i sar gnas shog /zhes pa'i zhal byang 'di'ang don gnyer de nyid kyi ngor/

ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //skal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa ston mchog gi /lung rtogs bstan pa ji srid bskal pa'i bar// 'dzin skyong spel ba'i byed por bka' bsgos pa'i// thub pa gnas brtan zhabs 'bring bka' sdod bcas// dbang po'i gzhu ris mdzes pa pham byed pa'i// phyag mchod bsod nams tshogs rab bsogs pa'i yul// blo bzang bstan dar zhes byas rgyu rkyen dag /legs sbyar sde dger grags pa'i sa'i thig ler// bskrun pa'i legs byas rta bdun kha lo pa// rgyal bstan ma zlum dkyil 'khor srid pa'i blar// bshad sgrub 'od stong 'bar bas sems can khams// bde 'byor chu skyes tshal kun rgyas phyir bsngo// zhes bris sku'i zhal byang 'di'ang 'tsho byed blo bzang bstan dar ba'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ //bsil ldan 'gro la bu gcig ltar brtse ba'i// 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal// bzo rigs byed pos ma bskrun rang byon skur// byin rlabs lha yi gos bzang 'di phul bas// bdag sogs lta byed dbang po nyams pa sogs// sngon las 'phral rkyen nyes skyon sdig sgrib sogs// mgon khyod mkhyen brtse nus pas reg pa'i mod// sgrib bral ye shes gzigs pa'i dga' ston stsol// bdag dang ltos bcas mar gyur sems can rnams// ngan song 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las sgrol nas// brtse dang byang chub sems sogs lung rtogs kyi// yon tan mi zad gter la dbang 'byor mdzod// lam mchog sgrub la bar du gcod byed pa'i// nad gdon dgra 'dre'i gnod pa mi 'byung zhing*// byung ba khyod zhal dran cing gsol btab 'phral// nyi 'od 'phrad pa'i mun ltar gzhil bar mdzod// rgyal sras spyod pa rmad byung gru gzings kyis// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i pha rol legs brgal nas// gsang gsum yon tan nor bus sems can gyi// re 'dod 'gengs pa'i mgon po mngon gyur mdzod// ces lha ldan gyi thugs rje chen po rang byon la/

snyan shal zhal gser 'bul ba'i 'dod gsol rkang mgyogs grub pa'i phrin yig ces pa 'di'ang*/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa don thams cad 'grub par gyur cig/ ༈ //thub pa'i dpal mgur tam+bu ras// lung bstan rab snyan dbyangs bsngags pa'i// rgyal tshab rje btsun kun dga' bzang*// yab sras gdan rabs bcas la 'dud// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i lus med thul// sras slob bka' sdod nor sbyin bcas// til gyi gong bu til gyi 'brus// mngon par gtams bzhin bzhugs pa la// bdag gzhan 'byung tshogs 'dus pa'i lus// grangs med sprul pa'i yan lag lnga// g.yar lam nor 'dzin gzhir btud pa'i// brgya phrag phyag gi phreng ba brtsegs// sgo gsum dge ba longs spyod bcas// ri gling nyi zla lha mi'i dpal// ma tshang med sprul mchod pa'i yul// rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar 'bul// rang bzhin bcas pa'i sdig ltung rnams// stobs bzhi rdzogs pa'i cho ga yis// mthol bshags bgyid na dag byed kyis// dri ma bkrus ltar sbyang du gsol// 'khor 'das dge ba'i chu gter la// yi rang zla 'od gsar pa yis// bla nas bla mar 'phel ba yi// dga' ba'i rlabs stong 'phyur bar bgyi// dpal stug dbang po snyigs ma yi// mi srun gdul dkas sun pa'i thugs// myang 'das dbyings su 'byon bzhed rnams// sems can don phyir rtag bzhugs gsol// chos smra mchog rnams btang snyoms su// bzhugs pa kun la theg gsum gyi// chos sgra 'byin pas gdul bya rnams// yang dag lam dkrir gsol ba 'debs// des bskyed dge ba'i 'dzam bu'i 'bras// byang chub snying po'i rgya mtsho cher// don gnyis 'grub pa'i sū war+ṇa// skye dgu'i nyer 'tsho mchog gyur cig /mthong na mngon dga'i gtsug lag khang*// yan lag bdun pa sngon 'gro ba'i// ngur smrig 'chang tshogs 'dus pa cher// spyan drangs bsnyen bkur mchod pa dang*// stong 'khun yul grur 'khrul bzo yis// thags su bskrun pa'i gos bzang 'phan// margad zhun mas sbags snyam bcas// phul ba'i legs byas gang yin des// dad gus nor can sbyin pa'i bdag

/dpal 'byor lhun grub gnyen 'khor rnams// skye ba 'di nas rnam mkhyen bar// dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i rten bzang thob// skyabs gsum gtsug gi nor bur bcangs// tshul khrims bslab pa'i lang tsho dar// rgyal sras spyod pa'i rgyan phreng bklubs// gsang chen zab mo'i bdud rtsi rol// lung rtogs rin chen rnam bdun gyis// dam pa'i go sar dbang thob pa'i// theg gsum smra ba'i rgyal po nyid// bstan pa'i rgyal srid dbang 'byor shog /lam mchog grub la phyi nang gi /bar chad sngo bsangs mun 'gribs tshe// dkon mchog thugs rje'i nyi gzhon gyis// nyer bcil bde ba'i 'od 'thung shog /ces pa 'di'ang skar chen spyi pa'i ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༈ //phyogs dang phyogs bral zhing gi stobs bcu pa// rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob slob ma rkyen gcig rtogs// bka' sdod mkha' 'gro chos srung nor sbyin lha// chu 'dzin phung po 'khrigs ltar bzhugs pa'i gnas// mthong na mngon par dga' ba'i gtsug lag khang*// sdom gsum ldan pa'i ngur smrig 'chang gi tshogs// 'dus pas lhag pa'i lha mchog dkyil 'khor che// sgrub cing mchod la rab 'byams mnyes byed cing*// ma hā tsi na'i gan mdzod las byung ba'i// gos 'phan pad+ma rā ga'i kha dog la// dbyar lngas mtshan pa dpyangs dang 'dus tshogs su// bsnyen bkur stob pas dgyes par skyed byed pa// dge slong sangs rgyas bzang po dge grogs kyis// dad gsum snying la bcangs te phul ba dang*// gang des nyer mtshon bdag gzhan 'gro tshogs kyi// sgo gsum dang 'brel legs byas gang bsags pas// dge ba'i sbyin bdag 'brel thogs ltos bcas kyi// rang bzhin bcas pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung rnams// nyal 'gro'i rgyun gyis lus la bgos pa'i dri// legs par bkrus ltar byang zhing dag gyur cig /bsod nams rin chen rdul brtsegs lto ba nas// 'chi med ring 'tsho'i chu klung chad med 'jo// dpal 'byor dbyar skyes lo 'dab rgyas pa'i khrod// bde skyid gzhan gsos mgrin glu len par shog

/tshe rabs phreng bar dal rten yol go ru// dad gus rin chen skyogs kyis legs bcus pa'i// chos spyod dge bcu'i zil dngar yongs 'khyil ba// rang gzhan thar pa'i gsos su len par shog /ces pa 'di'ang bdag med spyi pa'i ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༈ //nam mkha'i mthas gtugs phyogs bcu'i zhing khams na// dus gsum gshegs dang bzhugs pa'i gnyis med gsung*// rgyal sras nyan rang chos srung nor lhar bcas// kun la grangs med lus btud phyag bgyi'o// lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs// rab 'byams mchod sprin kun gsal mnyam pas mchod// skye ba lu gu brgyud bsags sdig sgrib dang*// nyes ltung ji snyed stobs bzhi tshang bas bshags// 'khor ba mya ngan las 'das 'gro ba yi// legs byas bsags dgur yi rang 'dzum gyis bklubs// ston mchog zhi bder gzhol la mngon phyogs rnams// smon lam rjes dgongs bskal par rtag bzhugs gsol// smra mchog rnams la dpal mgur g.yas 'khyil gyi// sgra las zab rgyas chos 'khor bskor bar gsol// nges bskyed dge ba'i chu gter bsrubs pa'i bcud// rnam mkhyen chos kyi nyi ma 'byung phyir bsngo// las bzang mthong na mngon dga'i dri gtsang khang*// thun mtshams dmar mdangs co 'dri'i 'dus tshogs kyis// dge chos spyod pa'i sgra dbyangs 'brug tu ldir// mchod yul 'phags tshogs dgyes pa'i bsnyen bkur bstabs// ma hā tsi na'i yul grur thags bskrun gyi// gan mdzod las thon sprin gyi rnga gsang ris// bkrag cher bkod legs bum pa brgya skyes kyi// kha dog la sdang gos 'phan dpyangs byed pa// bhik+ṣu grags pa bzang po spyi dge grogs// mchog gsum gtan gyi skyabs su bzung ba yi// bslab byar slob dang tshogs zung rdzogs bya'i phyir// phul ba'i rnam dkar bsod nams gang thob des// tshul 'dir rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag 'brel thogs kyis// nyer mtshon sems can kun gyi sgo gsum las// kha na ma tho gang bsags mun nang du// gsal sgron bteg ltar byang zhing dag gyur cig

/'di nas byang chub bar gyi dal rten bzang*// skyabs gsum rab 'byams mchod pa'i gom stabs kyis// zab yangs dge ba'i sa gzhi yongs bcal te// don gnyis grub pa'i gzhal med khang phyin shog /sarba pra ṇi dhāḥsid+dho bha wan+tu/ zhes pa 'di'ang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i spyi pa dge grogs kyi ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༈ //dpal ldan mthu stobs dbang phyug bi rū pa// dus 'dir lung rtogs chosaṃ tshul skyongaṃ byed pa'i// rdo rje slob dpon sgyu 'phrul zlos gar gyis// 'gro ba byang chub snying po smin mdzad mchog /gong de'i rtogs brjod rin chen 'byung gnas kyi// ya gyal sku gdung ril po'i snying po dang*// bde gshegs chos gzugs sku yi ring bsrel can// srid zhi'i dpal kun 'jo ba'i mchod sdong cher// nyer spyod mchod pa'i phreng bas mdun bdar te// snyan shal margad mdangs la 'khu ba 'di// skyabs mgon dam pa'i zhal lung bdud rtsi'i zegs// legs thob dpal 'byor lhun grub zhes byas phul// dge tshogs pad+ma'i rtsa bar kha ba'i ri// ston zla ltar dkar gang des sbyin pa'i bdag /ltos bcas gson gshin 'gro ba'i sgrib sbyangs nas// mthar thug thams cad mkhyen pa myur thob shog /de srid skye bar dal 'byor rten bzang thob// skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla mas rjes bzung nas// zab dang rgya che'i dam pa'i chos spyod cing*// bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i las byed shog /ces pa 'di'ang skar chen spyi bas bskul ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༈ //rnam gsal ra ri'i dri mas gos pa med// dmar phyogs bgrod pas cha shas bri min pa'i// rnam 'dren kun dga' bzang po'i kun phan gyis// lus can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gcod la bsngags// ci 'dod gsol btab dpal 'jo yid bzhin nor// yang na bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje nyid// gang yin dpyad ngor byang chub snying po'i bar// bde rab ster bas skyabs gsum yon tan dran// che mchog de dag ye shes gzugs snang du// legs shar 'gro don mdzad pa rten gsum gyis// yongs gtams mthong na mngon dga'i gtsug lag khang*// gang der kun mkhyen bstan pa'i rjes zhugs pa'i// dkon mchog blo gros zhes bya bka' lung gi

/bdud rtsi nod pa'i mos gus shing rtar brten// dkon mchog riṃn cheṃn gsum dngos snyan ngag gi /miṃ 'aṃgyur phreng tshogs bye bas bsngags pa'i yul// lung rtogs chos kyi rgyalaṃ mtshaṃn bslang ba'i phyir// rgyal bstan snying po sdom gsum 'dzin pa yi// ngur smrig 'chang rab 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi dbur// gur gum nags klung rgyas par nyin mor byed// rnam par rtsen ltar spyan drangs mnga' gsol nas// bdag dang mar gyur 'gro ba ngan 'gro dang*// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'jigs las skyob pa'i mchog /kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod// 'jug pa dbang bskur bcas pa'i gsung bskul zhus// rnam smin rang lus gcig nyid du ma'i gzugs// mngon par sprul te che mchog yon tan gyi// cha shas dran pa'i khur gyis ngal ba'i lus// g.yar lam sa gzhir yang yang ngal gso snyam// mchod yul rab 'byams dgyes pa'i mchod sprin spros// 'phags pa'i 'dus tshogs bsnyen bkur mchod 'bul bstabs// tsi na'i yul gyi 'phrul bzos btags pa'i gos// pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs 'tsher 'phan gyis mchod// tshe rabs phreng bar kha na ma tho'i las// gang dag bsags pa bshags shing sdom par bgyi// 'khor ba mya ngan las 'das bde ba'i rgyur// ji snyed bgyis par yi rang sems kyis spel// chos smra'i zla ba chu lha'i sa 'dzin rtser// son pa dgung sngon dbus su brtan pa dang*// ston mchog mi smra'i khang bur gzhol nye la// zab rgyas chos kyi rnga chen brdung bar gsol// 'dis mtshon dge ba'i ma dros chu gter las// tshad med rnam bzhis chu klung rtag 'bab pas// sgrib gsum nyes pa'i dri ma kun sbyangs nas// byang chub spyod pa'i rgya mtsho ro gcig shog /'gro tshogs srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral bya'i phyir// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ded dpon bla na med// sgrub pa'i lhag bsam ba dan rtser g.yo yang*// gal te skye ba lu gu brgyud gyur na// mi khom brgyad las ring 'das dal 'byor rten// 'dul 'dzin mchog gi zhabs bsten 'khor ba las// nges 'byung tshul khrims la gnas phyi nang gi

/gtsug lag rig gzhung 'dzin pa'i mchog gyur cig /theg chen lam gzhi byang sdom rtsa ba brling*// rgyal sras spyod pa'i yal 'dab phyogs su rgyas// sngags sdom me tog dam tshig ge sar dgod// rim gnyis snye mas kun nas dud gyur cig /thos bsam bsgom pa las byung lung rtogs kyi// yon tan nyi zla'i snang ba ches gsal bas// bstan dang 'gro la phan bde'i 'dab stong tshal// cig car bzhad pa'i byed po nyid gyur cig /ces dge slong dkon mchog blo gros kyis mkhan chen klu sdings pa tshogs dbur bzhugs nas stong chog btsugs pa'i tshe/ gtsug lag khang du gos 'phan phul ba'i 'dod gsol 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// // ༄༅// tshe bh+rum̐ dgon du karma 'chi med thub bstan rab gsal zhes grags pa'i sku brnyan gser zangs las grub pa sogs phul ba'i tshigs bcad sbrang rtsi'i mgrin glu zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i phrinaṃ laṃs sgyu 'phrul gar// 'chi med lam gyi mtha' klas 'gro ba la// brtse dang byang chub sems 'byongs sems dpa' ches// mkhas tshul gsum gyis thubaṃ bstanaṃ raṃb gsaṃl byed// bcu phrag rig gzhung mkhyen pas mkhas pa'i mchog /chos 'dul bslab pa lhur len btsun pa'i phul// mdo sngags zab mo'i don rtogs grub pa'i dbang*// lung rtogs bstan pa skyong ba'i mchog tu khums// gang gi snang brnyan bka' lung dgongs 'grel gyi// bzo thig las 'khrungs rgyal ba sras dang bcas// chos gzugs sku yi ring bsrel phung po can// rab 'byams sangs rgyas zhing sprul brling bar byas// dkon mchog gsum po gcig bsdus rdzogs pa'i sku// gsang gsum yon tan dran pa'i khur lci bas// dub pa'i yan lag rnam lnga g.yar lam du// lan cig min par ngal gsor spyod snyam byed// tshogs gsum phreng ba dngar ba'i 'chos skyob kyi// rtsom phud glegs bam nyer spyod bla bres mtshon// dngos dang yid sprul mig skya'i dpal 'byor gyi// khengs pa 'gog pa'i mchod sprin ci yang spros// skye ba lu gu rgyud bsags sdig ltung rnams// stobs bzhi tshang ba'i dag byed rgyun gyis bkru// 'phags bzhi so skye'i bsod nams bgyis so 'tshal// yi rang 'dzum zer dkar pos mdun nas bsu// che mchog yon tan ldan pa zhig gi lam// mngon par phyogs rnams gzhan don 'tsho gzhes bskul// smra ba'i dbang phyug grub rnams zab rgya che'i// chos lam snang chen 'gyed par gsol ba 'debs// 'dren mchog dam pa'i sku brnyan bskrun pa dang*// tshogs bsags yan lag bsgrub pa'i dge tshogs rnams// mar gyur 'gro ba srid pa'i duḥkha las// sgrol byed thams cad mkhyen pa thob phyir bsngo// de srid skye ba dal 'byor pad+ma dkar// phyi nang rig gzhung nyin byed 'od 'thungs pas// lung rtogs yon tan 'dab stong grol ba las// legs bshad bung ba'i dbyangs snyan 'jo bar shog

/ces tshe bh+rūm̐ karma 'chi med thub bstan rab gsal zhes grags pa'i sku brnyan gser zangs las grub pa dang*/ bzhugs su gsol ba'i khang bzang rtsom phud dkar chag glegs bam mchod 'bul phreng bas mdun bdaraṃ dus kyi yan lag bdun pa'i tshigs bcad sbrang rtsi'i mgrin glu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun dam pa'i legs gsungs bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas bris nas phul ba sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //skal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i lung rtogs chos// zla bral mkhas tshul gsum gyis 'jig rten khams// snang byed chos kyi rgyal po sa skya pa// yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i bka' drin bsam// rgyal gsungs dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i rgyud mangs las// lung bstan tshogs pa gsum pa'i dbyangs snyan gyis// mngon par bsngags pa'i rgyal tshab kun dga' bzang*// mang thos kun gyi sgra 'dzin dpyid 'jo ba// gang de'i rgyal tshab dam pa chos kyi khrir// 'khor los mtshan pa'i zhabs bkod theg gsum chos// dga' ston mgron du lus can yongs gnyer ba// mkhan chen rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan ches// de yi legs mdzad rin chen 'byung gnas las// thugs bskyed ri bos srub skyes lha rgyal srang*// gtsug lag khang bzang dgon sder bcas bskrun la// srid gsum dge legs yongs 'du zhes grags par// bla ma yi dam lha tshogs rgyal ba sras// bstan srung rab 'byams sprin ltar dkrigs pa'i mdun// margad zhun ma thags su btags snyam gyis// gos 'phan gyis mtshon kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// bstan pa'i bdag po 'jam dpal ngag gi dbang*// mi srid tshul bzung kun dga' blo gros pa'i// phrin las kha lo bsgyur ba chos kyi rje// sangs rgyas bzang po zhes byas gus par phul// dge bas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bstan// bshad sgrub bye bas dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel zhing*// bstan 'dzin skyes bu bskal brgyar 'tsho gzhes shing*// ngur smrig 'chang tshogs grangs med dar rgyas shog

/bstan pa legs bris grong khyer blar 'degs pa'i// snying stobs phrag pa rab brling sa skyong sogs// chab 'bangs kyis mtshon 'jig rten khams bde zhing*// tshe dang bsod nams rgya mtshor rtag spyod shog /ces phur pa chos rje sangs rgyas bzang po pas yid lhung lha rgyal srang gi gtsug lag khang du gos 'phan phul ba'i bsngo byang 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// sarba maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu// ༈ //bka' srol brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang*// dgyes pa rdo rje la sogs yi dam lha'i// bka' lung rdo rje'i rwa bar gnas bcas pa'i// bstan pa bsrung dang bstan dgra mthar mdzad pa// rdo rje gur gyi mgon po dral lcam dang*// gnyan mgon gdong bzhi ldan pa yum chen bzhi// gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring gsum// dur khrod dmag zor las kyi gshin rje sogs// bstan cing bsgrubs pa'i bka' srung 'khor bcas la// dngos 'byor yid sprul phyi nang mchod gtor dang*// ja dar rin chen rta phyugs bya khyi sogs// mthun rdzas gnam sa'i dal 'khor khyab pa 'bul// bstod bskul snyan pas 'bod la yus pa'i bu// skyed byed dam ma'i brtse bas mi bor ltar// dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor yon mchod la// bsrung bskyab thugs rje'i skyong ba ma g.yel zhig /sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i 'byung gdon tshogs// khros pa'i rnam 'gyur nad rims bar chad rigs// dus min 'chi ba'i keg srir ldang ba rnams// khyed cag gsol ba btab 'phral zhi bar mdzod// chos srid dpal 'byor bde skyid sgrub pa'i rten// ring por 'tsho ba'i tshe dang bsod nams stobs// dpal 'byor longs spyod rdzogs ldan nga la nu'i// mnga' 'byor 'di na yongs su 'phos snyam mdzod// thams cad mkhyen rgyu phyi nang rig pa'i gzhung*// thos bsam bsgom pa'i bya ba rmad byung las// byung ba'i shes rab ye shes 'od po ches// 'khor ba'i sgrib gsum mun pa drung 'byin mdzod// yul gru 'dis mtshon bod yul 'gro ba rnams// nad mtshon bkres rngabs skal ngan tsher ma'i nags// gang dag gzings dgu bstan srung mthu stobs ches// skad cig nyid la bsreg pa'i phrin las mdzod// bde dga' legs bris dga' tshal rgyas pa'i khrod// dge chos spyod pa'i sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan tshal// phun tshogs bde bzhi'i ge sar dgod pa'i nang*// bde skyid bung ba'i ga zha 'byin mdzod cig

/ces bstan srung tshogs la 'dod don bskul ba'i tshigs bcad bsam don kun 'grub zhes bya ba 'di ni rdzong chen mgo'i don gnyer dag gis bskul ngor ban+de tshul rin gyis so// ༈ //bka' babs bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang*// bstan srung rdo rje gur mgon 'dod khams bdag /dpal mgon sring bzhi pu tra ming sring lnga// dur khrod dmag zor beg tse bstan srung tshogs// khyed rnams dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas 'di bzhes la// bstan pa'i rjes 'jug dad ldan btsun pa 'di'i// dkor rdzas nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams// chom rkun rtsal gyi rku 'phrog bgyis song ba// bstan srung thugs rgyud bskul ba'i mthu nus dang*// ma byin blangs pa mi dge'i rnam smin gyis// rkun ma nor bcas da lta mngon sum nyid// mthong bar 'gyur ba'i phrin las ma g.yel cig /ye shes spyan gsal rdzu 'phrul 'gog pa med// mthu stobs rtsal gyis 'gugs par mi nus pa'i// 'jig rten 'di na sra brtan su zhig yod// gang phyir btsun pa 'di yi yo byad rnams// ma nor myur du mthong thos 'byung ba dang*// des na khyed cag min pa su la re// las ngan mkhan yang chad pa las grol zhing*// phan tshun bde ba rgyur bcas spyod par shog /zhes pa 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༈ //bskal bzang sems dpa' stong las thugs bskyed stobs// rmad byung dus 'dir 'tshang rgya'i tshul bstan nas// bcu gnyis mdzad pas 'gro ba byang chub tu// smin mdzad bstan pa'i bdag po shākya thub// su zhig mtshan gyi rol mo rnar sim pa'i// tshe rabs du ma'i sdig ltung skad cig mar// sbyong byed thugs rje'i gaṅgā 'gro rgyud la// legs par 'bebs pa'i sangs rgyas sum cu lnga// mgron lhar bcas pas yongs bskor sku'i snang brnyan// byi ru'i rtsig log rin chen sgron ma stong*// tshar du dngar ltar mthong don che ba 'di// dge slong kun dga' chos 'phel dad pas bzhengs// 'dis mtshon 'khor 'das dge ba'i zla 'od kyis// sbyin bdag gtsor byas 'gro ba'i nyes ltung gi

/gdung ba bcil nas tshogs zung chu yi gter// rab rgyas yon tan ku mud bzhad par shog /de srid skye ba kun du dal 'byor rten// dkon mchog gsum la dang 'dod yid ches kyi// bde dga' rgyas pas tshul khrims bslab par gnas// chos spyod dge bcu'i sgrub pa 'phel rgyas shog /ces par dpon kun dga' chos 'phel gyi thub dbang gtso 'khor gyi bris sku bzhengs pa'i bsngo smon 'di'ang ban+de tshul rin gyis so// ༈ //rgyal ba'i gsang gsum yon tan phrin las las// rgyal bstan srung ba'i byed por mngon sprul nas// rgyal ba rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rim byon gyis// rgyal bstan srung spel gnyer gtad g.yar dam can// rdo rje gur gyi mgon po 'dod khams dbang*// gnyan mgon gdong bzhi ldan pa sring bzhi bcas// gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring dang*// ru 'dren dur khrod dmag zor bstan srung tshogs// bdag cag rnal 'byor slob 'bangs bcas rnams kyis// phyi nang dam rdzas mchod pas mdun bdar zhing*// bstod dbyangs bstan pa rgyas pa'i las bskul la// dges pas tshur gson bsam don sgrubs shig kye// ljongs 'dir phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan// yongs 'dzin smra ba'i rgyal po sa skya pa// yab sras khu dbon gdung rabs rim byon dang*// kun dga' bzang po rgyal tshab bcas rnams kyi// bstan pa'i bshad sgrub bskal pa'i yun dar zhing*// mkhas tshul skyong ba'i bstan 'dzin grangs med 'byon// rjes 'jug klog spong 'khor lo dbang 'byor ba'i// ngur smrig 'chang ba bgrang yas 'du bar mdzod// brtse chen thabs shes yi ges mtshan bstan gyi// lugs bzang lta bsgom spyod pa lhur len pa// 'dus tshogs gang dag byon rnams gnas skabs dang*// mthar thug 'bras bu gegs med g.yur za mdzod// phyi nang shes bya'i gzhung lugs brgya phrag la// thos bsam bsgom pa las byung shes rab mig

/dkyus ring 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i phrin las kyis// snang ba dam pas 'jig rten mdzes par shog /de dag phrin las 'khor lo ring ba yi// nor 'dzin ljongs su 'khod dgu'i skye bo rnams// dbang med yid 'phrog dad pa'i yid bsgyur nas// mchod yul dgyes pa'i dga' ston 'gugs par mdzod// de mthus yul gru 'dis mtshon rgyal khams su// gang 'khod lus can bsod nams sa gzhi brling*// tshe yi gaṅgā rgyun ring srid dang zhi'i// dpal 'byor rin chen 'byung gnas spyod par mdzod// rnal 'byor yon sbyor 'khor dang bcas pa kun// gnas skabs dal 'byor rten bzang ring 'tsho yi// chos srid 'byor pa'i chu gter rgyas pa'i klong*// sems kyi ngang mo dga' brgyas rtsen par mdzod// smra don yang dag grub pa'i mtha' 'di la// ma dad log lta'i dug chus cher myos nas// skyabs gzhan 'tshol dang chos brgyud gzhan phyogs su// gom stabs 'chol bar spyod pa'i skal ngan tshogs// bstan srung khyed cag mthu rtsal cher bskyed la// bstan dgra'i tshogs dang lhan cig dngos rgyud bcas// tshar gcod drag po'i phrin las mi sgrub na// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul che bas ci bgyir yod// rang phyogs dpag bsam rgyas pa'i grib bsil du// lhag bsam mi 'gyur dge ba'i mal stegs 'cha'// thun mong mchog gi dngos grub ci 'dod la// dgyes dgur rtsen pa'i bkra shis dga' ston stsol// zhes lha rgyal srang gi mgon khang bdud dpung zil gnon gsar bskrun nang gi bstan srung gtso 'khor rnams la bstan pa rgyas pa'i las bskul ci 'dod dpag bsam zhes bya ba 'di ni/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis gtsug lag rab gnas skabs su gzims skyil rdo rje'i pho brang du bris pa sarbār+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //sarbo3r+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu/ ye shes dag pa'i spyan gsal rdzu 'phrul gyi// snang bas gang du bgrod la thogs med pa// bstan srung rdo rje gur mgon lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi dpal mgon sring bcas dur khrod bdag

/gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring gsum// ru 'dren sde bzhi dmag zor rab brtan ma// beg tse lcam sring pe har a gu ra// brten cing bsgrub pa'i lha srung khyed cag rnams// mthun pa'i rdzas kyi mchod kyin bskul ba ni// dkon mchog gsum gyi rten dang dge 'dun gyi// gtsug lag khang bcas bsrung ba gnyer gtad na// rten dang mchod pa'i yo byad che gras rigs// mi srun chom rkun rigs kyis ma byin len// 'phrog bcom byed pa gang dag byung ba la// nad gdon zug rngu mi mthun bar chad tshogs// myur rtags ston pa'i mthu rtsal mnga' bzhin du// rgyal bas ma byin len gyi nyes pa cher// gsungs pa'i bka' don 'gal bar bgyid pa rnams// las ngan brtson pa'i rang rtags da lta nyid// ston par mi mdzad mthu rtsal dgongs pa ci// bstan dang bstan 'dzin dgos pa'i yo byad rnams// dkon mchog mchod dang 'dus tshogs bsnyen bkur ched// khyed cag gnyer gtad bya ba'i 'os mchis pas// bcol gtams bor brlag med pa'i phrin las mdzod// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' lung dam tshig dang*// bdag cag rnams kyis bsrung ba ma lus pa// mthu ldan khyed cag thugs rgyud bskul ba'i mthus// bsam don snye ma g.yur du za bar mdzod// ces 'di gdong thog chos rje yi// mchod rdzas nyer spyad mi srun gyis// gzhan dbang gyur dogs sangs rin pas// bskul ngor tshul rin zhes pas bris// ༈ //swasti sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu/ gang gi bka' lung rdo rje'i phrin yig gis// bsgos pa tsam gyi ye shes 'jig rten pa// kun kyang bran bzhin dbang sdud bsam pa'i don// la gor sgrub pa'i bla ma lha yis skyongs// rgyal ba'i bstan pa bstan skyong sbyin bdag gi /bsam don 'grub pa'i gur mgon 'dod khams dang*// gnod sbyin pho mo pu tra ming lcam gsum// dur khrod las kyi gshin rje beg tse sogs// rdzu 'phrul mngon shes mthu stobs dpag yas kyi// phun tshogs sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor dge legs tshogs// mkhyen rab bsod nams stobs ldan mi mchog rgyud// kun nas dbang 'dus chos ldan bsam rdzogs mdzod// khyad par las bzhi lhun grub mthu rtsal stobs// myur mgyogs zhal bzhi ldan pa bram ze'i gzugs// sring bzhir bcas pas brtse chen e waṃ pa'i// lugs bzang bskal par skyong ba'i snying stobs can// dad gus blo gros rgya mtsho'i gos can gyi// nor 'dzin skyong la dbang bsgyur skyed byed mo// mngon 'dod lha sras dpag bsam rkang 'thung gi

/dal rten sdong bu yal 'dab bskyed bsring mdzod// 'dod gzugs khams kun dbang bsgyur dmag zor lha// phrin las myur ma khyod kyis nor 'dzin skyong*// phun tshogs dbang mo'i dpal du legs bris bu// bar srid dbang bsdus gegs med bskyed bsring mdzod// thub dbang chos dang 'jig rten bde 'byor gzhi// mi bdag rigs mchog khams gsum phyogs kun nas// las bzang bar srid khugs la nor 'dzin skyong*// dbang thang rigs sras spel ba'i mthu ma chung*// sngar bcol bsam don grub pa'i gtang rag dang*// da jus sa skya pa dang e waṃ pa'i// bstan srid bla mar 'degs pa'i srid zhu mkhan// rigs mchog rgyun mi chad pa'i las bcol phyir// dngos 'byor blo gros mdzod brgya phye ba las// phyi nang mchod gtor mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis// bskal par mchod pas bsod nams stobs ldan gyi// sa skyong rigs rgyud 'phral du 'byung bar mdzod// sarbār+tha ni ra bho gaṃ kur wan+tu// ༈ //na mo bud+dho3mo gha sid+dha ye/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus dngos brgyud bla ma yis// bstan pa bstan 'dzin chos kyi sbyin bdag bcas// rtag tu 'phel rgyas skyong ba bka' bsgos shing*// rdo rje'i tha tshig snying gar bris pa'i don// zhal 'ches bstan srung gur mgon lcam dral dang*// zhing skyong gdong bzhi 'jigs rung yum chen bzhi// gnod sbyin pu tra ming sring ru 'dren sde// dur khrod dmag zor la sogs bstan srung tshogs// tshur gson rgyal bstan spyi dang kun dga' snying*// kun dga' bzang po brgyud par bcas rnams kyi// lugs bzang dri med 'dzin skyong spel ba la// lhag bsam khur 'degs sde dge sa skyong gi /bstan jus bskal par 'phel rgyas byed pa'i sras// rigs stobs blo gros bsod nams shugs che ba'i// bar srid khams gsum gnas na gang yod pa// mi bdag yab yum sras su sbrum mdzod cig

/bstan srung khyed cag bsten cing sgrub byed pa'i// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag dgos don che dus 'dir// bstan srung mthu rtsal nus stobs ma chung bar// bstan srid rgyas pa'i rigs sras myur du stsol// srid pa'i dpal 'byor kun gzhi lha yi sras// la gor bskrun cing bskyed du bsring ba la// gegs byed 'dre gdon dgra bgegs byad ma yi// nyer 'tshe tsher ma'i tshang tshing gzings gyur na// ye shes spyan gyi mi gsal 'ga' med phyir// mthu stobs drag sbyor bskal pa'i mer mtshungs pas// skad cig nyid la thal bar bsregs nas ni// sbyin bdag bsam don lhun gyis grub par mdzod// rigs byed dga' mas dbang gi lcags kyu bskyod// sa gsum khongs nas rigs stobs 'byor dregs kyi// bar srid dbang bsdus sa bdag skye ba ru// bka' srung rdo rje'i rwa gur chud par mdzod// sarbār+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //sarbār+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu/ bsam pa tsam gyis khams gsum lha mi klu'i// las bzang 'gro ba bde bzhi'i dpal 'byor gyi// phywa g.yang thams cad yid kyi shing rta ru// rang dbang 'gugs pa'i mthu dang rdzu 'phrul gter// bstan srung rdo rje gur mgon lcam dral dang*// las bzhi lhun grub zhing skyong gdong bzhi pa// yum chen sring bzhi gnod sbyin pho mo dang*// pu tra ming sring dmag zor dur khrod bdag /khyed cag mthun pa'i dam rdzas phyi nang gi /mchod gtor spyan gzigs gnam sa'i khyon gang ba// dngos 'byor yid sprul bstod dbyangs 'brug stong sgras// mchod 'bul 'di bzhes phrin las bskul ba ni// rgyal ba'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin dge 'dun bcas// 'phel rgyas thabs dang bsnyen bkur stob byed pa'i// chos ldan sa skyong sde dge'i gdung rgyud mchog /mi nyams ring du gnas la rag las phyir// phun tshogs sde bzhi dge bcu'i phrin las kyi// 'khor los sa chen dbang bsgyur rigs kyi sras// phyogs bcu gar yod gnas nas dbang bsdus la// lha lcam sras su sbrum pa'i skal bzang mdzod// dgos pa rmad byung gang phyir bskul byed na// rdzu 'phrul myur mgyogs rlung gi rta la chibs// mthu stobs nus pa'i phyag stong brkyangs nas ni// la gor rang dbang 'byor pa'i phrin las sgrubs// bka' srung mthu rtsal grub pa'i bden pa dang*// lhag bsam mchod bstod drag tu bskul ba'i mthus// bsam don snying po'i snye ma da lta nyid// smin rgyas mchog gi dga' ston stsol cig kye// ces pa'i dgos skabs kyi 'phrin bcol 'di rnams kyang ban+de tshul rin gyis so// swasti war+dha bha wa tu//

༈ //na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ yid la bsam don gang yin rnam pa kun// gegs med sgrub pa'i phrin las rdzu 'phrul stobs// bsam mi khyab bdag gur mgon dral lcam dang*// gdong bzhi ldan pa'i dpal mgon sring bzhi bcas// dgyes bskyed dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin// nam mkha' mnyam pas mchod la dgyes par rol// dpal ldan bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas la// zla dus mchod pa rtag gnas rgyun 'di ko /bstan pa ji srid gnas par 'gro rgyud kyi// sgrib gnyis sbyang dang tshogs zung rdzogs bya'i phyir// mi nyams rgyun du bsring ba'i phrin las ni// bstan srung khyed cag gnyer du gtad do kye// sa ma ya sma ra ku ru/ zhes pa 'di'ang bla ma mchod pa'i rgyun 'dzugs skabs su bstan srung gnyan po la gnyer gtad du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༈ //rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' dang dam tshig gis// gnyer gtad bstan srung mgon po rnam gnyis sogs// bsten cing mchod pa'i bstan srung mthu bo che// 'bod do tshur gson mchod gtor rgya chen bzhes// rnal 'byor bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la// sngon las 'phral rkyen dgra 'dres gnod pa'i shugs// gang yin 'byung khams lus 'khrugs dge min ltas// gang shar 'bras bu mi 'byung myur zhi mdzod// mi mthun bar chad kun las rnam rgyal nas// tshe srog ring 'tsho dbang lnga rnam gsal zhing*// bsod nams mnga' 'byor mkhas pa'i phrin las rnams// sprin dus chu gter bzhin du cher rgyas mdzod// ces pa 'di'ang 'dod don gsol ba'i ched du tshul rin gyis bris pa'o// ༈ //oṃ sarbār+tha sid+dho bha wa tu/ rgyal ba'i gsung gi gces mdzod 'dus pa sogs// bsrung dang spel phyir phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i// rang gzugs bstan dgra dam nyams srog gi gshed// bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong ba'i nag po che// mthu stobs ye shes rdo rje gdengs tsam gyis// bdud dgra'i ri bo'i rgyun lugs yongs bcad de// rgyal bstan rgyas pa'i 'dzin mar bstan 'dzin gyi// 'gro tshogs bder skyong zhing skyong lha brgya'i mgon// srid bzhi 'jigs ma'i rnam 'gyur dran tsam gyis// yid srubs bgegs dgra'i don snying khar lud pa'i// mi bsrun tshar gcod yum chen sring bzhi dang*// bka' nyan las byed dregs pa'i sde tshogs bcas// rdo rje 'chang nas kho bos 'dren mchog bar// brgyud pa'i bka' lung 'phrin yig thugs ka la// bkod ltar bstan la gus ldan bdag cag gi

/'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen kun 'grub mdzod// dge chos sgrub pa'i dal rten ring 'tsho la// gegs 'phrang lo zla zhag dus keg ngan dang*// sri rigs langs pa'i nad yams gdon bgegs kyi// gnod 'tshe 'chi ba'i 'jigs tshogs zhi bar mdzod// rang gzhan rkyen chag bde ba'i shugs byung gi /brag cha'i lad mo ltar 'phos nyer 'tshe dang*// sa sogs 'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa'i mi mthun phyogs// thams cad khyod zhal dran pas zhi bar mdzod// pha rol bsam sbyor ngan pa'i sbrul gdug khas// byad gtad rbad zor gnod pa'i kha rlangs dug /gang dag 'tshubs par byung tshe khyed cag gi /mthu stobs nus pa'i sngags kyis bzlog bsgyur mdzod// bsod nams rin chen las grub gzhal med khang*// ring 'tsho tshe yi ka ba brgya stong brling*// bslab gsum rgyan rdzogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas// kun rig mig stong ldan pas rtag rtsen mdzod// bstan 'gror phan pa'i rten 'brel gang mchis pa'i// khengs dregs sems kyi 'dod ldan gzhon nu dag /'gugs byed yab kyi mtshar sdug zur mig gis// reg tsam rang dpal rtse gcig 'dun par mdzod// chos sgrub mkhas tshul gsum gyi phrin las la// bar du gcod byed mi dang mi min dgra// su dag mchis pa drag sbyor me bo ches// rtsa phung bsregs ltar thal bar brlag mdzod cig /rang gzhan mngon par shes pa'i ā dar+sha// lkog gyur gti mug dris nongs ma mthong ba// khyed cag ye shes gzigs pas gsal ba'i don// bdag la rmi nyams kun du lung ston cig /kun gzigs brtse ba che dang e waṃ pa'i// lugs bzang zla bral legs bris grong khyer che// mkhas pa'i phrin las rmad byung snying stobs kyi// lhun po'i phrag pas 'degs pa'i skal bzang mdzod// bstan srung 'khor bcas mchod pa'i mthu nus dang*// dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor lhag bsam stobs// rgyu 'bras bslu med chos nyid mi 'gyur ba'i// bden pas gang bcol phrin las 'grub gyur cig

/ces pa 'di'ang dgos skabs zhig tu tshul rin rang gis bris pa'o// ༈ //rgyal kun bgrod pa gcig lam rdo rje'i theg /dbang bskur gdams ngag dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// lhag pa'i lha mchog rnams kyis bka' lung gi /dam tshig rdo rje'i rwa bar gnas bcas pa// bka' srung rdo rje gur mgon lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi ldan pa'i dpal mgon yum chen bzhi// gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring gsum// ru 'dren bzhi sogs bstan srung rgya mtshor bcas// khyed rnams dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas dngos 'byor dang*// yid kyi byed pos sprul pa'i bskang rdzas kyi// kun gsal dga' ma'i bzhin ras yongs khengs pa// bstod dbyangs rol mo'i sgrar bcas 'bul lo bzhes// deng 'dir lha srung mchod byed sbyin pa'i bdag /dge grogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i sgo gsum gyi// bar chad nad gdon dgra 'dres 'tshe ba rnams// snang bas mun pa'i dpung bzhin zhi bar mdzod// mthun rkyen 'chi med tshe dang bsod nams stobs// chos dang srid pa'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs rnams// sprin sngon dus kyi lag 'gro'i grong khyer bzhin// dri med ches cher 'phel ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces pa 'di'ang sgar chen spyi bas bskul ngor tshul rin gyis bris pa'o// ༈ //rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam gur lcam dral// gnyan mgon gdong bzhi ldan pa yum chen bzhi// gnod sbyin pho mo pu tra ming sring sogs// dur khrod dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor bcas dgongs// sbyin bdag 'di yi zong sogs dngos rdzas rnams// chom rkun khyer ba'i brku byas nyes pa che// zhes gsungs bden pas yid brnag mi gnyis sogs// gang yin dngos rtags cho 'phrul ston mdzod cig /bstan srung mchod pa'i mthu dang bdag cag gis// blo gtad las bcol bgyis gang da lta nyid// ma byin blangs pa'i nyes skyon mngon sum du// mthong ba'i phrin las thogs med sgrubs shig kye/

sarbār+tha sid+dhī rastu/ zhes pa 'di'ang don gnyer gyis bskul ngor tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// // ༄༅// bka' srung tshogs la rang gis 'dod don phrin las bcol ba bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bcom ldan kye yi rdo rje'i gsang gsum gyi// sgyu 'phrul rnam rol rdo rje gur lcam dral// zhing skyong dbang phyug gdong bzhi yum chen bzhi// las mgon lnga dang ru 'dren sde tshogs dang*// dur khrod dmag zor las gshin beg tse can// bstan srung khyed cag deng nas byang chub bar// dal 'byor lus rten dus dang dus min 'chi'i// sgo gsum bar chad zhi ba'i dgos par dgongs// tshul khrims gsum 'chang rnam bkra shis pa'i dpal// gtsug lag rin chen nor bu yongs bzung nas// slob 'bangs bcas pa bstan 'gror phan 'dod kyi// bsam sbyor brtsams dgu lhun gyis grub par mdzod// gang tshe bro rigs gdon dang dgra 'dre yis// rnam par 'tshe ba'i bden bral co 'dri na// bstan srung mthu rtsal dga' byed mda' gzhu yi// 'khrul 'khor sbyor bas tshar gcod phrin las mdzod// bsod nams rin chen lhun po'i spo ltar mtho// 'chi med tshe ring gaṅgā'i rgyun ltar bsring*// dpal 'byor chu gter ltar 'khyil lung rtogs kyi// yon tan nyi zla'i 'od ltar ches gsal mdzod// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag brtse chen e waṃ pa'i// lugs bzang dri med 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yi// phrin las zung gi snang ba ring 'gyed la// gegs med brnag don snying po g.yur za mdzod// bla ma yi dam byin rlabs thugs rje dang*// bka' srung mthu rtsal che myur bden pa'i stobs// bdag gis mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// gang dag bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par shog /'di'ang mgon khang du snyan shal 'bul ba'i tshe ban+de tshul rin gyis so// ༈ //gur mgon gdong bzhi la sogs bstan srung tshogs// mchod gtor bzhes nas sbyin bdag gzhi byes bcas// dgra 'dre bar chad gnod pa las bsrung zhing*// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod// zhes pa'i 'dod gsol 'di'ang 'phral du bris pa'o//

༈ //rtag tu brten cing mchod pas mnyes byas pa'i// bstan srung gur mgon dral lcam gdong bzhi pa// yum chen rnam bzhi gnod sbyin yab yum dang*// pu tra ming sring ru 'dren sde tshogs bcas// gzhan yang dmag zor dur khrod yab yum sogs// bstan srung tshogs rnams mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// sbyin bdag gzhir gnas byes song mi phyugs la// gshin 'dre 'byung gdon gnod pas mi tshugs par// khyed cag mthu stobs nus pas mtshar bcad cing*// nyer zhi phyin chad mi 'byung bsrung ba yi// rdo rje'i gur khyim yangs par ring 'tsho zhing*// bsod nams dbang thang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod// 'di'ang bskul ba po'i ched du tshul rin gyis so// ༈ //smin byed dbang bskur byin rlabs gdams ngag gi /bka' srol dngos brgyud bla ma lhag pa'i lha// bstan srung gur mgon dral lcam gdong bzhi sring*// las mgon dur khrod gshin rje beg tse sogs// bstan srung 'khor bcas deng nas byang chub bar// mgon skyabs rten gling dpung gnyen nyer bzung nas// phyi nang mchod gtor dam rdzas spyan gzigs bstar// bsgom bzlas bsnyen sgrub lhur len rnal 'byor bdag /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor yon tan rnams// dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel rtag tu bkra shis shing*// rang gzhan don 'byor mthar thug tshogs zung gi /snying po dbang phyug brgyad ldan thabs mdzod cig /ces pa 'di'ang bkra shis dbang phyug mgon blar bskos dus kyi 'dod gsol du shī la rat+nas so// ༈ //swasti bi dza yan+tu/ dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang ba nas// bdag gi 'khor lo'i mgon bar gyi// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' lung gis// bsgos don sgrub pa'i bstan srung che// rdo rje gur mgon 'dod khams bdag /zhing skyong gzi ldan sring bzhi bcas// gnod sbyin yab yum bdud pu tra// bha ṭa srin mo ru 'dren sde// dur khrod dmag zor re wa tī// beg tse lcam dral srog bdag dmar// gri thogs shen pa'i sde tshogs rnams// tshur gson dgos don bcol la dgongs// sa skyong sde dge'i chab 'bangs 'khor// dgra yul dmag dpung btegs so 'tshal// pha rol byad ma lha srung gi

/mthu dang gnod pas mi brdzi zhing*// mda' gri mdung rnon me mda' sgyogs// mtshon char gnod pa thams cad kyis// mi lus bzhon par mi tshugs par// phyir bzlog bstan dgra'i gshed du phob// rang phyogs dmag tshogs ji snyed kyi// bsrung bskyab rgyab brten dpung grogs la// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul sprul pa dang*// yang sprul dpung tshogs cher skyed cig /mi bzad dgra bo'i g.yul chen las// rnam par rgyal ba'i dbyangs snyan gyi// ru mtshon srid pa'i rtser bsgreng ba// bstan srung khyed cag grogs su spyon// gnam bskos mi bdag bka' don ltar// las byed kun la rgyal blon thugs// 'gal zla'i khrims skyon mi 'byung ba// bde dga' dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel mdzod// sarbār+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu/ ces bstod bskul dbyar gyi rnga gsang zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dbang phyogs gong ma chen po nas rgyal rong du las dmag brdzang dus/ sde dge sa skyong blo gros rgya mtsho par dmag g.yar dgos tshul phebs pa ltar dmag dpung nyung shas btang skabs bstan srung rnams la las bskul dgos tshul stsal ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa dge legs rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig/ ༈ //srid pa mya ngan las 'das chos ma lus// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med 'khor lo yis// mngal sgyur khyab bdag dgyes pa rdo rje dang*// gnyis min dag gi dpal ldan bla mar 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang nas bdag cag gi /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i bar du byon pa'i bkas// gsang rgyud bstan pa bstan 'dzin bshad sgrub sogs// bsrung spel sbyong ba'i byed por gnyer gtad pa// rdo rje gur gyi mgon po lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi dpal mgon drag gtum yum chen bzhi// las byed mgon po gnod sbyin pho mo dang*// pu tra ming sring gsum dang ru 'dren sde// nor skyong dur khrod yab yum dmag zor rgyal// las kyi gshin rje beg tse lcam dral te// brten cing bsgrubs pa'i lha srung drag rtsal dang*// rdzu 'phrul mthu ldan 'khor tshogs bcas pa la// dgyes par bskyed pa'i phyi nang mchod pa'i sprin// dam rdzas gtor ma spyan gzigs dkor nor sogs// gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor khengs pa'i bskang rdzas kyis// thugs dam bskangs nas phrin las bskul ba ni// rnal 'byor bdag gi rigs dbon 'khor dang bcas// 'dren mchog bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog gsum// bstan srung la sogs mchod yul rab 'byams kyi// spyan ldan tshogs bsags mchod pa 'bul ba dang*// bstan pa'i snying po so thar byang sdom dang*// rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa'i lta sgom spyod// thos bsam sgom pa'i nor bu legs blangs nas// rang gzhan don du sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i phyir// dbus gyur 'chang dang gtsang gi gdan sa cher// dpal ldan sa skya e waṃ chos ldan du// yar 'gro mar 'ong lam gyi gnas skabs kun// dgra jag chom rkun lam 'phrang chu bo sogs// 'jigs pa kun las rtag tu bsrung skyob dang*// kha 'dzin rgyab brten ma g.yel brtse ba'i mas// gces pa'i bu ltar mi dang bzhon pa phyugs// gegs med bde bar 'byor ba'i phrin las mdzod// dam chos slob la yid srub snying zhugs kyi// bslu brid rtse 'jo'i gegs byed gang byung ba// bstan srung mthu dang rdzu 'phrul dpung bskyed la// dbye bskrad bsgral ba'i phrin las ma g.yel cig

/phyi nang 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad gdon dang*// bar chad dus min 'chi ba kun zhi zhing*// dgra 'dre'i ngan sngags byad gtad rtsod slong dang*// khyed cag thugs rjes nyer zhi phyir bzlog mdzod// mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dang*// thos bsam bsgom pa las byung shes rab blo// rnam dkar phrin las thams cad dbyar dus kyi// rin chen 'byung gnas che ltar rgyas par mdzod// bla ma dkon mchog bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// yi dam lha tshogs thugs rje bstan srung tshogs// mthu rtsal che zhing las bzhi lhun grub pa'i// bden pas smras don snye ma g.yur za mdzod// ces lhun grub steng gi nub shar gyi mgon khang du bskang gso snyan shal 'bul ba'i 'phrin 'chol smras don gegs med sgrub pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang gi tsha bo bkra shis nor bu 'khor bcas gtsang dbus su bteg pa'i skabs su ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas bris pa don thams cad grub par gyur cig/ ༈ //rgyal kun gsung gi gsang ba yid 'phrog gzugs// gtsug lag rab 'byams rgyud mangs glur 'jo bas// skal bzang ngag gi dbang phyug la sbyor ba'i// dran pas blo gros mchog sbyin dbyangs can lha// lus can thams cad mkhyen lam sbyor ba'i thabs// bcu phrag rig pa'i bstan pa bsrung spel che// mi bzad srin mo khros pa'i rnam 'gyur gyi// bstan dgra tshar gcod dmag zor srid pa'i rgyal// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bgrod pas stong gsum khams// yud kyis bskor bzod chu srin seng ge'i gdong*// bdud phrug mig rtsa dmar khros bye ba dang*// ma mo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor tshogs grangs med bcas// byang chub bar gyi 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen ci 'dod sgrub pa'i srung ma cher// rtag tu brten cing dam rdzas mchod pas brngan// 'dod gsol bcas pa'i snyan shal 'di bzhes la// bcom ldan gshin rje gshed nas bdag cag gi

/yongs 'dzin dam pa gang dag byon rnams kyi// bsgo ba'i 'phrin yig snyan po snying gar bkod// spyi bor rdo rje'i rgya yis btab don bzhin// kun mkhyen bstan pa'i snang byed sa skya pa'i// bstan pa dpyad gsum rnam par dag pa yi// phrin las rgya mtsho'i gos can yongs khyab pa'i// lus can sgrib gsum gshed du rgyu bar mdzod// chos don dpyod pa'i blo gros mkha' lding khyu// bshad sgrub mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol mkhas pa// bslab gsum 'chang ba'i ngang ngur grangs med kyis// phyogs bral bsam pa'i rol mtshor rtsen par mdzod// rnal 'byor bdag cag slob 'bangs tsha rgyud bcas// dal rten bde ba'i bdud rtsi 'thung ba la// gzhan gyi byad gtad gnod pa gang brtsams pa// bzlog pa gnod byed de de'i gshed du phob// phyi nang 'byung tshogs 'khrugs pa'i nye zho dang*// mi srun 'thab rtsod geg dang srir ldang ba'i// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad gdon dus min 'chi// khyod zhal dran pas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// gzhan don thams cad gzigs pa sgrub pa'i thabs// bcu phrag rig gzhung sbyong dang sbyang 'gyur blo// shel dkar me long ngos kyi ltad mo bzhin// chos don rtogs pa'i gzugs brgya bkra bar shog /chos 'dul bslab pa'i dpag bsam sdong po brling*// rgyal sras spyod pa'i yal 'dab phyogs su rgyas// rim gnyis bsgom pa'i 'bras bu g.yur du za// phrin las 'dod dgu'i dga' ston rgyas par mdzod// ces dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i rten la phyag mchod stob pa'i 'dod gsol don yod zhags pa zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarbār+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //gsol ba btab dgu'i 'dod don kun sgrub pa'i// bstan srung gur mgon lcam dral gdong bzhi ldan// las mgon dur khrod mgon dkar dmag zor sogs// bstan cing bsgrubs pa'i chos srung tshogs rnams dgongs// deng dus dam chos thos bsam bsgom phyir dang*// bla ma dkon mchog mchod 'bul ched dmigs pa'i// mi dang rta phyugs nor rdzas btang 'di rnams// na shi bor stor mi 'byung bsrung mdzod cig

/dgra jag gcan gzan lam 'phrang chu bo'i 'jigs// kun las srung skyob kha 'dzin rgyab brten du// bstan srung khyed cag gnyer du gtad bgyid na// bsam don thams cad 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces gnas skabs dgos don sgrub pa'i 'dod gsol 'di'ang ban+de tshul rin gyis so// ༈ //gur mgon zhal bzhi la sogs bstan srung tshogs// bdag lus sngon las 'phral rkyen nad gdon bgegs// mi dang mi min gnod pa'i bar chad kun// nyer zhi tshe dpal phrin las rgyas par mdzod// zhes pa 'di'ang sga len steng mgon khang du snyan shal kha byang du tshul rin gyis so// ༈ //khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang nas bdag cag gi /'dren pa mchog rnams bka' lung dgos don ltar// dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor dpon slob kyi// bsam don phrin las gang bcol sgrub mdzad pa'i// bstan srung gur mgon lcam dral gnyan mgon che// gnod sbyin pu tra ming lcam sprul yang sprul// dur khrod yab yum dmag zor beg tse sogs// bstan srung las byed 'khor tshogs bcas pa rnams// bdag cag dgos don sngar bcol gang dang gang*// gegs bral legs par grub pa'i gtang rag dang*// slan chad brtsam bya ma lus bsgrub phyir du// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pas mdun bdar ba// zhi drag phyi nang nyer spyod ye shes lnga'i// rang bzhin byin brlabs gtor ma ri ltar spungs// rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis rtags brgyad dang*// 'dod yon lnga dang dar zab spyan gzigs sogs// dngos su 'byor dang ser sna med yid kyis// mngon par sprul pa'i mchod sprin 'di bzhes la// 'di nas byang chub bar gyi gnas skabs dang*// mthar thug brnag don bsgrub bya'i phrin las ni// ngagaṃ dbaṃng dgeṃ legaṃs lhunaṃ grubaṃ zhes bya bas// dam chos sgrub pa'i gegs 'phrang kun bsal nas// bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin lung rtogs yon tan dang*// mkhas tshul gsum gyi phrin las 'phel rgyas mdzod// bdag cag gnyen 'khor bcas pas bsam pa'i don// chos srid dpal 'byor 'byung gzhi rang dbang du// legs thob mi nor longs spyod phun tshogs stobs// bde rgyu dge 'byor rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// phyi nang 'byung 'khrugs las gyur nad gdon bgegs// pha rol bsam sbyor ngan pa'i byad gtad sogs// nyer 'tshe thams cad bstan srung khyed cag gi

/yon tan dran pa'i 'phral nyid phyir bzlog mdzod// mdor na dge chos sgrub pa'i sgo gsum gyi// keg 'phrang bar chad 'jigs pa kun bsrung zhing*// bde dga' dge chos las bzang bsod nams tshe// phan tshun 'gran zla byed bzhin rgyas par mdzod// sarbār+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //gang la gsol btab brtsam pa'i bya ba kun// thog mtha' bar kun gegs med bkra shis shing*// bsam don yid bzhin 'grub byed bla ma dang*// yi dam lha tshogs gur mgon lcam dral sde// gdong bzhi dpal mgon yum chen las mgon lnga// ru 'dren dmag zor rgyal mo dur khrod bdag /las kyi gshin rje beg tse lcam dral sogs// bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i lha srung bdag la dgongs// srid zhi'i dge legs bkra shis 'byung ba'i gzhi// donaṃ kun 'grubaṃ la yid dga'i mdza' na mo// bsod nams khab tu khug la dal 'byor gyi// chos ldan lha bu rgyun mi chad spel zhing*// gzhir gnas byes bzhud rnam pa thams cad du// dgra jag chom rkun 'tshe ba kun bsrung zhing*// bsam doṃn ci 'dod dpal 'byor kun thob cing*// bde dga' lhun gyis grubaṃ pa'i stong grogs mdzod// gdon bgegs 'byung po 'khrugs pa'i kha yi rlangs// mi nad phyugs nad 'brum 'thor la sogs pa// 'go ba'i nad gdon nyer 'tshes mi tshugs par// srung skyob rdo rje'i gur khyim chud par mdzod// ces pa'i phrin bcol gong 'og 'di gnyis kyang rang gi rigs dbon ser skya'i gegs sel du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig sarbār+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //na mo gu ru sh+tsa shrī he badz+ra ya/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs las sprul pa'i sras// las bzhi phrin las lhun grub nag po che// gur mgon e ka dzā ṭi 'dod khams dbang*// zhing skyong dpal mgon yum bzhi dregs pa'i sde// gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring gsum// ru 'dren dur khrod yab yum dmag zor rgyal// las kyi gshin rje beg tse lcam dral sogs// mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul che ldan srung ma'i tshogs// mi zad mkha' mdzod dbang bsgyur khyed cag la// gyi na'i mchod pas phongs pa mi srid mod// bdag don phrin las bskul phyir dngos 'byor dang*// yid kyi mdzod sgo phye ba las byung ba'i// zhi drag nyer spyod gtor ma'i ri bo bstar// dar zab go mtshon spyan gzigs rta phyugs sogs// bstod dbyangs rol mo'i sgrar bcas mchod pa 'di// gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes shig gu// rnam 'dren kun dga'i ring lugs rjes zhugs nas// chos rab 'phel ba'i las byed sbyin pa'i bdag

/sngon las 'phral rkyen las gyur gdon bgegs kyi// nyer 'tshe'i bar chad ji snyed zhi bar mdzod// mthun rkyen ring por 'tsho ba'i tshe bsod nams// bde dga' longs spyod mi zad dbang 'byor zhing*// srid zhi'i dge legs rnam dkar phrin las rnams// dbyar dus chu gter ji bzhin 'phel rgyas mdzod// dkon mchog gsol btab mi bslu'i bden pa dang*// bstan srung khyed cag mchod cing bskul ba'i mthus// sbyin bdag keg 'phrang bar chad kun bsal nas// bsam don 'bras bu lhun gyis grub par mdzod// zhes bstan srung tshogs la 'dod don gsol ba 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor ngag dbang tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarbār+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //na mo gu ru tsadhi de wa rā bh+yaṃ/ su zhig gsol mchod la dges 'dod pa'i don// sgrub la thogs med rdzu 'phrul mthu che zhing*// phrin las glog ltar myur ba'i rgyal po dang*// gza' mchog dam can ma mo'i sde tshogs bcas// khyed cag sngon chad gsol mchod 'dod pa'i don// gang bcol legs par bsgrubs pa'i gtang rag dang*// da dung brtsams don kun la gegs med du// la gor sgrub pa'i phrin las bcol ba'i phyir// dngos shom yid sprul phyi nang nyer spyod dang*// 'dod dgu'i dpal 'jo dam rdzas gtor ma dang*// bdud rtsi sman dang rak+ta dar gos sogs// spyan gzigs bstod dbyangs rol mo'i mchod sprin stobs// dgyes par bzhes nas bdag cag gnyen 'khor bcas// bsam don kun nas 'grub pa bkra shis kyi// rang dbang phun tshogs zla ba'i ma ma bzhin// dgyes dgur rtsen pa'i skal ba sbom por sbyor// chos dang srid pa'i bu slob bde skyid gang*// bsod nams dpal 'byor dbang thang ring 'tsho ba'i// tshe dang bsod nams phan tshun gcig la gcig /'gran pa bzhin du rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i ngagaṃ la dbangaṃ 'jo zhing*// dgeṃ legaṃs phun tshogs rnam dkar phrin las la// lhunaṃ gyis grubaṃ phyir bod phyogs lhag pa'i lhar// bsnyen cing sgrub pa gegs bral stong grogs mdzod// mdor na at+ma nap+ti grogs 'khor gyi// bsam don bar chad byed pa'i mi min mi// gang yin mthu rtsal drag pos tshar bcad nas// smras don dpag bsam ljon pa bskyed bsring mdzod// ces pa'i gsol ka khang du 'phrin bcol 'di'ang ban+de tshul rin gyis bris pa'o//
