༈ //rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar// gang dag byon pa'i bka' lung dam bzhag gi /sa ngor bstan pa sman 'dogs khur che ba// tshul rin rang gis bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i lha// gur mgon lcam dral gdong bzhi lcam dang bcas// gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra bha ṭa sring*// ru 'dren dmag zor rgyal mo dur khrod bdag /phyogs skyong las kyi gshin rje'i sde tshogs dang*// beg tse lcam dral gnod sbyin gri thogs brgyad// ma mo the'u rang tshogs bcas bstan srung tshogs// bdag cag keg sri rtsub mos shi gyur kyang*// 'di nas sa lam bgrod pa'i stong grogs mdzod// slar yang brtse chen snying po e waṃ pa'i// bstan pa rtsod pa kun las grol ba'i chos// byams chen chos kyi snang ba shar de srid// phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam grub pa'i phyir// bar srid rnam gsal rig pa'i gnas bcu dang*// mdo rgyud dgongs pa dpyod pa'i blo ldan gyi// skye ba'i zlos gar dal 'byor lus bsgyur la// gegs med phrin las sgrubs shig bstan srung tshogs// rgyal sras spyod pa skyong phyir bar srid kyi// sprul sku dal 'byor ldan pa'i skye ba yi// gtsug lag phyi nang chos kyi 'od po ches// bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen byed par shog /bar srid sprul sku myur byon gsol btab kyis// 'bras bu la gor smin pa bla ma dang*// yi dam dkon mchog gsum dang bstan srung tshogs// gsol btab snye ma g.yur du za bar shog /gnyen 'brel gyis sbrel bdag gi tsha bo gsum// phan tshun byams brtse'i mdza' bas nyer bcings nas// sri zhi'i bde 'byor tshe dpal bsod nams stobs// dbyar mtsho lta bur kun nas 'phel rgyas mdzod// ces pa'i phrin bcol 'di'ang rang nyid 'tsho 'chi'i 'phyang mo nyug skabs su gson pa'i rkyen bzlog dang 'chi ba'i sa lam gyi gegs sbyong*/ slar yang bstan pa la phan pa'i rgyal sras mkhas pa'i bar srid myur byon gyi smon lam 'di bzhin dgos zhes bu slob ngag dbang dge legs lhun grub dang*/

dbu mdzad bla ma kun dga' bsod nams dang nye bar gnas pa lhun grub phun tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor bris pa bsam don gegs bral du 'grub par gyur cig/ ༈ //phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kun 'dus bdag /rnam gsum tshul khrims ldan pa la gnas nas// gtsug lag sde snod theg mchog rin chen gyi// gzhung lugs kun mkhyen dpyod 'drar byin gyis rlobs// mgon bla kun dga' bsod nams kyis bskul ba'i ngor tshul rin gyis so// ༈ //sarbār+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu/ phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i mtha' med zhing bzhugs pa'i// bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas chos de sras// bstan srung spyi dang 'dod dgu'i re bskang nyid// gur mgon lcam dral zhal bzhi sring dang bcas// las kyi mgon po mgon dkar dur khrod bdag /dmag zor rgyal mo rigs byed dga' mar bcas// srid zhi'i ci 'dod lag rtser sbyin pa la// khyed cag bsten cing sgrub pa'i dgos pa ni// nor 'dod thar pa dge bcu dar bab kyi// snyan grags ring 'tsho'i tshe dang bsod nams stobs// thams cad rdzogs ldan dus kyi 'khor los bsgyur// sde 'khor dpung dang bcas pa lhags snyam 'dir// gcig tu lnga rig sde snod rgyud sde'i don// mkhyen dpyod gsal ba shī la rat+na yi// bar srid bstan 'gror phan pa'i phrin las can// blo ldan sprul sku myur 'byon byin gyis rlobs// skyabs gsum thugs rje che myur bden pa dang*// rgyal ba sras bcas bstan srung rdzu 'phrul mthus// dal 'byor chos smra mkhas pa myur byon nas// bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces gsol btab gegs sel dang sprul sku myur 'byon gyi smon lam bsam don kun 'grub ces bya ba 'di ni/ sa skyong nor 'dzin dbang mos rgyun du 'don byar dgos zhes bka' lung gis bskul ngor rgyal ba zhes pa'i zla

7 tshes 11 la ban+de tshul khrims rin chen rang nyid snga lam du bteg nye bar lhun grub steng rgyal khab tu 'phral bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ ༈ //dpal ldan bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras// bstan srung bka' sdod tshogs rnams ma g.yel thugs// khyed rnams mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rtsal bskyed la// sa skyong yab yum 'brel zab chos smra bdag /bar srid mnyam gnas dal 'byor rten thob par// bcu phrag rig pa sde snod rgyud sde bzhi'i// lta sgom spyod pa kun la thogs med du// mkhyen dpyod smra ba 'jam dpal dbyangs 'dra shog /bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*// bstan srung nor lha'i rdzu 'phrul mthu rtsal dang*// bdag gi smon lam 'bras bu gang btab pa// gegs med g.yur du za ba'i phrin las mdzod// zhes pa'i 'dod gsol 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen rang nyid snga lam du bteg nye'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i skabs kyi gsol 'debs dbang gi lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// skyabs gnas kun 'dus 'dren mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs// tshul khrims rnam gsum lha rdzas gos kyis klubs// mthar phyin drug gis rin chen rgyan phreng mdzes// lung rtogs glegs bam ral gri'i mtshan la 'dud// chos 'dul bslab pa rin chen drwa bas spras// phyi nang rig gzhung smra ba'i mche ba rno// rgyal sras spyod pas gnyis 'thung lus stobs rgyas// rim gnyis gom stabs mkhas pa'i phul la 'dud// phung po dbyings bcas rnam dag rgyal ba drug /khams drug dga' ma skye mched sems dpa'i tshogs// yul drug lha mo tshigs chen bgegs dgra bcu// gar gyi 'gro ba byang chub smin byed rgyal// de ltar bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa ni// zab lam don gnyer bdag cag lta bsgom spyod// zung 'jug sa lam yon tan mthar phyin nas// tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub thob par shog

/skye dgu thams cad 'chi ba'i lam nyid du// ma song rang dbang bsdad pa su zhig yod// bdag kyang de 'dra nam shi cha ma 'tshal// mi rtag 'chi bas sems rgyud bskul bar shog /gzhir gnas skye 'chi bar do'i rnam par rtog /sbyong byed bskyed dang rdzogs pa zung 'jug gi /rnal 'byor bsgoms pas sangs rgyas chos gzugs kyi// yon tan bdag gi rgyud la mngon gyur shog /nam zhig mi tshe lus sems zug rngu bral// bla ma yi dam lha dang rang sems gsum// dbyer med 'phos pas mkha' 'gro'i dbang po ltar// sangs rgyas zhing kun thogs med bgrod par shog /de nyid mngon gyur bar gyi tshe rabs phreng*// mi khom brgyad las rab 'das dal 'byor rten// khyod zhabs gus bsnyen bcu phrag rig pa'i gzhung*// thogs med mkhyen pa'i blo mchog bskyed du gsol// rgyal gsungs sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i// mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i lam gnad 'doms pa las// bsnyengs bral chos dang chos mig dpyon pa'i blos// bstan la mkhas pa'i las gsum bgyid par shog /mgon khyod deng dus byang chub mchog brnyes tshe// theg gsum bdud rtsi 'gyed pa'i 'khor tshogs kyi// thog ma'i gtso bo nyid du bdag skyes nas// bka' lung sdud sogs bstan pa'i las byed shog /gal te byang chub spyod pas skye nas skyer// 'gro don rlabs chen 'byung bar gzhol dgongs pa// gang tshe zab dang rgya che'i legs gsungs kyi// zil dngar rtag tu 'thungs pa'i skal bzang mdzod// skyabs kun 'byung gnas ston pa sangs rgyas nyid// skal dman 'gro 'dul rdo rje slob dpon du// zlos pa'i don mdzad legs gsungs bden pa yi// gsol ba gang btab snye ma g.yur za shog /ces kho bor skyabs gnas kun 'dus su bstod cing gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas skabs kyi legs smon gsol 'debs dbang gi lcags kyu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dbang khrid zab chos kyis bu slob gyur pa rnam par dpyod ldan 'tsho byed tshul khrims 'od gsal gyis 'di ltar dgos tshul byung ba yid lhung shu gur chab tshan du bris pa la/

slar yang rang nyid snga lam du btegs nye ba na bdag gi rigs dbon ngag dbang dge legs lhun grub kyis skye ba nas tshe rabs kyi bar du rjes su bzung ba'i gsol 'debs zhing*/ gnang dgos zhes bskul ngor 'di kas 'thus tshul dang bcas slar 'byin 'jug cung zad bgyis te ban+de tshul rin gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa sarbār+tha sid+dhi bha wa tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
